Abo basalidwe kubelekela mutempele: lunyungu lwa Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth,
Keros, Siaha, Padon,
Lebanah, Hagabah, Akkub,
Hagab, Shalmai, ambi o Hanan.
Lunyungu lwa Giddel: Gahar, Reaiah,
Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam,
Uzza, Pasea, Besai,
Asnah, Meunim, ambi o Nephusim.
Lunyungu lwa Bakbuk: Hakupha, Harhur,
Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha,
Barkos, Sisee, Temah,
Neziah, ambi o Hatipha.
Lunyungu lwa babelesi ba Solomon: lunyungu lwa Sotai, Hassophrerth, Peruda,
Jaala, Darkon, Giddel,
Shephatiah, Hattil, Pokereth-Hazzebaim, ambi o Ami.
Lunyungu lwabo ba bambilidwe kubeleka mutempele o lunyungu lwa babelesi ba Solomon antomwi lwali 392.
Abo bakazwa ku Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addon, ambi o Immer-kono takwe nibakakonzya kutondezya kuti bana Isilaili-
antomwi lunyungu lwa Delailah lwali 562, Tobiah, ambi o Nekoda.
Ape, kuzwa ku lunyungu lomupaizi: lunyungu lwa Hobaiah, Hakkoz, ambi o Barzillai (oyo wakagwiswa mwanakazi wakwe kuzwa kubana ba Barzillai woku Gilead ambi walikwitwa izyina lwakwe)
Bakayandola mangwalo amazyalo abo, pele takwe nibakajana, mponya bakagwisigwa kuzwa kubunanike bokuba mupaizi kambo tabasalali.
Mponyina mwendelezi wakabambila kuti tabeilede kulya zyipo zyisalala zyizyonse atina mupaizi wabuzya kuli Urim o Thummim.
Kabunga aka antomwi kali 42,360,
kugwisya babelesi balumi aba belesi banakazi ( aba bali 7,337) ambi abaimbi betempele balumi abanakazi(myanda yobile).
Mahosi abo ali: 736. Ma mule: 245.
Inkamele: 435. Imbongolo: 6,720.
Nibakainka mun'anda yo Mwami mu Jelusalemu, mupati wecikombelo wakabapa nguzu zyokuti bayake n'anda ya Leza, kuti baipilusye mponyina piyabede.
Bakapa kwindila mbonya mbubakonzyezya kumayake: myanda ili chisambomwe-atomwi engolide, myanda ili yosanwe ya nsiliva, ambi o myanda womwe wotunanike tumu paizi.
Mponyina bapaizi ama Levi, bantu, baimbi betempele aba bangilila mulyango, abo bakambilwa kuti kababelekela mutempele yamasena abo. Bantu bonse bali mu Isilsili bali mumasi abo.
Ijwi lya Nehemiah mwana mwalumi wa Hakaliah: ino cakacitika mwezi wa Kislev, mumwaka wa kamukumi obile, nindali mucisi cipati ca Susa,
eyo yomwi yomuzyalwama, Hanani, ambi abamwi balumi boku Juda bakaza, ambi ndakababuzya kwendalanya ama Jew, abo bakacija, abo bakacija kuzwa kubuzike, ambi okwendelanya aba Jerusalem.
Bakamba kuli mebo, ''abo bali muzibaka bakakonzya kufutuka kuzwa mubuzike bali mumapenzi ambi okuvwisya luse akambo kobwanda bwa Jerusalem bwakajuka, ambi emilyango wakatentwa omululo.''
Mponya mponya nindakavwa majwi aya, ndakakala ansi okulila, ambi kwamazuba ndakazumanana kulila okulimya kulya okukomba kuli Leza wokujulu.
Mponya ndakamba, ''Ndakomba, ndamikumbila, Mwami, Leza wejulu, Leza mupati ukomosya, oyo ubamba cikonke okwima nji muluyando abo bamuyanda ambi okubamba malailile,

Imenso enu ajuke ambi amatwi enu avwisisye kutegwa mukonzye kuvwa inkombyo yomuzike wenu eyo njemukombela sikati amasiku kubantu bana Isilayeli bazike benu. Ndili mukwamba zibi zyabana Isilayeli, ezyo zitwamubisizya. Mebo antomwi ena'nda yabatata twakamubisizya .
Twakacita zibi kuli nwyebo, ambi takwe nitwakabamba malailile, zibumbwa, ambi ezyeledwe kucililwa ezyo ziwakambila Mozesi muzike wako.
Ndakomba yeye majwi ngiwakambila Mozesi muzike wako, ' kuti na upone kotakwe lusyomo ambi okusyomeka kuli mebo, ndiyo kugwisya akati kabantu,

ambi kuti wapiluka kuli mebo ambi okucilila malailile angu okwacita, mponya bantu bako bakagwisigwa kuzwa kujulu lyaansi, ndiyo bagwisya kuzwa oko ambi okubeta kunyika eyo njindaka basalila oku kweyosiya zina lyangu.'
Ino mbazike bako ambi bantu bako, abo muwakafutula kwindila enjuzu zyako zipati ambi ejanza lyako lidide.

Ndakomba, ndakukumbila, Mwami matwi ako aswilizye inkombyo yomuzike wako ambi enjunzu yomuzike wako oyo wakalipa kuti alumbaizye zina lyako. Ino pa kuzwidilila kumuzike wako sunu, ambi mufwide luse mumenso oyu munu,'' ndakabeleka ku mwami wangu mbuli musyomi.
Mumwezi wa Nisan, mu mwaka wa makumi obile a Artaxerxes mwami, wakasala wini, ambi ndakaibweza ukwipa mwami. Ino takwe nindakalivwa bubi kubusyu bwakwe.
Kono mwami wakamba kuli mebo, ''Ino ninzi cinso cako cilinyemide? toboneki kuba ucisidwe. Eci ceci cinyemya moyo.'' Mponya ndakayowa loko.
Ndakamba ku mwami, ''Mwami apone kutamani! Ino cilanywemena nzi cinso cangu? cisi, cibaka cezumbwe zyamatata, zikede mubuyo, ambi emilyango yakanyonyonywa omulilo.''
Mponya mwami wakamba kuli mebo, ''Ino uyanda kuti ndicite nzi?'' Mponya ndakamba kuli Leza wokujulu.
Ndakamutaba mwami, ''Kuti na ciboneka kabotu ku mwami, ambi na muzike wako wacita kabotu mubusyu bwako, welede kundituma ku Juda, kucisi cezyumbwe zyamatata, kutegwa ndikaiyakulule.''
Mwami wakanditaba (ambi o mwanakazi wakwe walikede kumbali lyakwe), ''Ino citola cindi cilafu buti koikide ambi noyopiluka?'' Mwami waliboteledwe kundituma nindakamupa cindi celelede.

Mponya ndakamba ku mwami, ''Kuti na cilamubotezya mwami, mangwalo apegwe kuli me kubendelezi bamabbuzu alikule omulonga kutegwa bandizumizye kwinda muzibaka zyabo neyabuya ku Juda. Ape akube lugwalo lumbi lwa Asaph mulangilizi wo mwami kutamani,
Ndakaza kubendelezi bama bbazu andilila milonga ambi okubapa magwalo o mwami. Ino mwami wandituma antomwi
Mponya Eliashib mupaizi mupati wakabelekela antomwi abapaizi bezinyina, ambi bakayaka mulyango utegwa mulyango wembelele. Bakainyamuna okwibikila zilyango bwelede. Wakanyamunya kusikila
Mumazuba a Xerxes (oyu Xerxes wakalela kuzwa ku India okwindilila kusika ku Cush, kwama bbazu ali mwaanda amakumi obile ociloba),
muli ayo mazuba mwami Xerxes wakakala acibbula co bwami mucibaka ci cingilizidwe ca Susa.
Mu mwaka watatu mukulela kwakwe, wakapa pobwe kubapati pati aba zike bakwe. Bendelezi boku Persia oku Media, balumi balemekwa, bendelezi bezibaka balimubuleli bwakwe.
Wakatondezya buvubi bwakwe obulemu bwakwe bwajasi kubenzu, kwamazuba ali 180.

Aya mazuba nakamana, mwami wakapa mpobwe lyakasekelelwa kwa mazuba ali ciloba. Lyali mpobwe lya bantu bonse mu Susa, kuzwa kubalemekwa kusikila ku bacete. Lyakapangilwa mukati ke gadi mukati mucibaka cakwe.
Cibaka ce gadi cali bambiwe kabotu amasila atuba, asubila kanini, ape ajesi mubala usubila kanini, alikulenjelela kutukoto twe nsiliva kuzwa kumatakozyo.
Zyokunywa zyakabambwa mukomoki zye golide. njaya komoki yaliindene ambi kwali wani inji akambo kobubotu bo mwami.
Kwali wani inji akambo kokuti mwami walikuyanda kuti benzu banywe mbuli mbubayandila, mulieyi nzila takwe wakasonjelezigwa kunywa ngwaya wakapegwa mbuli mbwayandila.
Ape, mwanakazi omwami wakapa pobwe kubanakazi mun'anda wo mwami Xerxes.
Mubuzuba bwasabata, awo mwami navwide kabotu mumuyo wakwe akambo ke wani, wakambila Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, igth, Abagtha, Zethar, ambi o Karkas (bapati bati bali ciloba bakamubaelekela),
mukweta mwanakazi omwami kulinguwe. Walikuyanda kutondezya bubotu bwakwe bantu abapati pati, kwanzwa kwakwe kwali kubotu.
Kono mwanakazi omwami wakakaka kuza kwendelana ejwi lwakazwa ku mwami. Mponya mwami wakanyema; bunyemi bwakwe bwali mukati kakwe.
Mponya mwami wakambola abalumi bazibidwe kuti mbasongo, bazikaboyu ma).

Ino abo ali afwi anguwe bali Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, ambi o Memukan, bana bumwami bali ciloba boku Persia ambi o Media. balipedwe nguzu kumwami, ambi balijesi bapati pati
.....''Mukwendelana omulawo, cinzi cilukede kucitwa kumwanakazi omwami Vashti kambo wakakaka kutobela zyamba mwami Xerxes, intume wakatumwa abapati pati?''
Memukan wakamba akati ko mwami abapatipati, ''Kukali buyo ku mwami banakwe Vashti balubizya, ape okubantu abapati pati boonse bali mucibaka ca mwami Xerxes.

Banakazi boonse bayovwa zyacita mwanakazi omwami. Ciyobapa kuti ambabo batakacilizyi zyambwa abalumi babo. Kabati, 'Ensi mwami Xerxes wakambila bantu kuti bamwetele mwanakazi wakwe Vashti kulinguwe, kono wakakaka.'
Ezuba kalikana kubbila onse mwanakazi omuPersia o mu Media wavwa zyacitika oyomba ziswana kubapati pati bomwami. Kunoli kunyansilizya kunji oku nyema.

Kuti na cilabotezya ku mwami, tuma ntume kuzwa kuliyebo, ambi u lemba mumulawo wa Persian aba Medes, oyo utakozigwi kugwisigwa, kuti Vashti katasiki kuliyebo. Ape mwami ape busena bwakwe kumwanakazi welede kuba acibaka cakwe.
Bakuvwa bonse banakazi mucisi cako, bonse banakazi bayolemeka balumi babo, kuzwa kulibabotu kusiila kubabi.''
Mwami abana bakwe bakabotelwa kukambo ako, ambi mwami wakacita mbuli Memukan mbwakamba.

Wakatuma mangwalo mumasi onse, cisi ecisi mubulembo bwaco, ambi bantu abantu mumushoo wabo. Wakalailela balumi bonse kuti babe mbabendelezi mumanda abo. lugwalo olugwalo lwakapegwa kwindila mumishobo yabo.
Nizyakainda zyintu ezi, mwami Xerxes nakanyemunuka, wakayeya banakwe Vashti ambi ezyakacita. Wakayeya omulawo ngwakabika kwendelanya ezyakacita.
Mponya kapaso wo mwami wakati, ''Mwami tumuyandodwe banakalindo babotu.

Amuleke mwami asale balangilizi muzibaka zyonse zyecisi, kutegwa babunganye banakalindo bonse antomwi okutweta kucibaka eco cikala banako mu Susa. Mponya mubaleke babe mumanza a Hegai, mupati pati wo mwami, oyo upedwe nguzu ku banakazi, ambi abape ziyandikana.
Oyo nakalindo uyo botelezya mwami pele nguyoba mwanakazi ku mwami acibaka ca Vashti.'' Majwi aya akabotezya mwami, ambi wakacita mbonya.
Kwali mwalui omwi mu Juda mucibaka cicingilidwe ca Susa wezina lwa Mordecai mwana wa Jair mwana mwalumi wa Shimei mwana mwalumi wa Kish, walimu Benjamite.
Wakatolwa mubuzike kuzwa ku Jelusalemu abo bali mubuzike kale kubikilizya o Jehoiachin, mwami wama Juda, oyo mwami Nebuchadnezzar mwami wama Babylonia ngwakabika mubuzike.

Walikumubabalela Hadassah, oyu utegwa Esther, mwana wabasimizyakwe, kambo talikwe banyina abaisi. Oyu nakalindo wali kalikabotu ape kalibumbidwe kabotu. Banyina abaisi nibakafwa, Mordecai ngwakamulela mbuli mwanawakwe wokuzyala.
Ino ntume wo mwami niyakavwigwa, banakalindo banji baaketwa kucibaka cikwabilidwe ca Susa. Bakapegwa mumanza a Hegai. Esther anguwe wali akati kabo bakatolwa mumanza a Hegai, mulangizi wabanakanazi.
Nakalindo oyu wakamubotezya, ambi wakajana luse ku mwami mukufwambana zibelesho zyamubili ezilyo. Wakatuma bazike bali ciloba kuti babambe busena bubotu mun'anda yabanakazi.
Esther takwe nambilide naba omwi kwazwa, kambo Mordecai wamwambilede kuti atambi.
Mazuba onse Mordecai walikwendeenda kazunguluka lubuwa mukuti azibe bukale bwa Esther, ezitacitwe kulinguwe.

Ino nako niyakasika kuli banakalindo kuti bainke ku mwami Xerxes-nakamana kucilizya milawo yabanakazi kwamazuba ali makumi obile, kambo njenako nimana yokubabotezya. Mwezi ili cisambomwe yamafuta ambi ili cisambomwe yotunikilizyo ezimwi-
Nakalindo nakainka ku mwami, kufumbwa cayanda calikupegwa kulinguwe kuzwa kun'anda yabanakazi, kuti atole kun'anda yomwami.
Kujolezya welede kwinka, ambi kuseni welede kupiluka kun'anda yabanakazi, ambi mumanza a Shaashgaz, mupatipati wo mwami, mulagi wabantu. Takonzi kupiluka ku mwami kuti na katamwitide.

Ino cindi ca Esther nicakasika(mwana wa Abihail, simizyakwe Mordecai, oyo wakamubweza mbuli mwana wakwe) kuti ainke ku mwami, takwe nakabuzya nikuba ciliconse pele buyo zyakamba, Hegai mupati pati wo mwami, walikulanganya banakazi. Ino Esther wakajana bulumbu kwinda banakazi bonse.
Esther wakatolwa ku mwami mu mwezi wefwuka, oyo ngo mwezi wa Tebeth, mumwaka we ciloba mubuleli bwakwe.
Mwami wakamuyanda Esther kwinda banakazi bonse ambi wakatambula bulumbu, kwinda banakalindu bonse. Mponya wakamuzwatika citulu cobwami ambi okumupanga kuti abe mwanakazi wakwe kutainsi Vashti.
Mwami wakapa pobwe mpati kubapati pati bakwe ambi abazike bakwe, ''Pobwe lwa Esther,'' mponya wakaimika mitelo muzibaka zyonse. Ape wakapa zipo kwendelanya obulemu bwakwe.
Ino banakalindu nibaka bunganisigwa antomwi kwecindi citobela, Mordecai walikede kumulwango wamanjililo.
Esther talina kwambila uli onse bantu bakwe na kwazwa, mbuli Mordecai mbwakamulailila. Wakaindilizya kucilila zyamba Mordecai, mbuli mbwakacicita nali mwana munini.
Mumazuba ayo, Mordecai nali kede amulwango wamanjililo, bapati pati bo mwami, Bigthana o Teresh, balikolonda mulwango wamavwido, bakanyema okuyeya kuti bacitecibi ku mwami Xerxes.
Ino nkani niyavwigwa kuli Mordecai, wakambila mwanakazi wo mwami Esther, ambi Esther wakambola o mwami muzina lwa Mordecai.
Kambo aka kakalanganisigwa, ambi balumi bobile aba bakajaigwa. Cakacitika eci cakalembwa, omwami kaliwo, mubbuku lilembwa zicitika mubuleli bwakwe.
Nikwakainda zintu ezi, mwami Xerxes wakamunyamuna Haman mwana wa Hammedatha mu Agagite, ambi okubika cibbula cakwe kwinda bapati pati bonse bali anguwe.
Bonse bazike bo mwami bali kumulyango wamanjililo bakafungama oku mulemeka Haman, mbuli mwami mbwakabalailila kuti bacite. Kono Mordecai takwe nakamufungamina na kumulemeka.
Mponya bazike bonse balikumulyango wamanjililo bakati kuli Mordecai, ''Ino nzi notocilili malailile o mwami?''
Balikumwambila sikati amasiku, kono wakakaka kuvwida zibalikwamba. Ino bakambola o Haman kuti bavwe kuti na kambo aka Mordecai ninga kalekwa buyo, kambo wabambilide kuti mu Jew.
Ino Haman nakabona kuti Mordecai takwe nakafungama okumulemeka, Haman wakanyema.
Walikuyandisya bubo kujaya Mordecai, kambo bazike bo mwami bakamwambila kale bantu bakwe. Haman wakayeya bubo kujaya ma Jew, bantu ba Mordecai, bali mucisi ca Xerxes.

Mu mwezi okutanguna (oyu ngo mwezi wa Nisan), mu myaka ili makumi obile a mwami Xerxes, mu Pur-nkokuti munji-wakasowigwa musule lya Haman, mukusala buzuba omwezi. Bakagwisya zinji kusikila mane myezi ili makumi obile (oyu ngo mwezi wa Adar).

Mponya Haman wakamba ku mwami Xerxes, ''Kuli bantu bamwi basalangene muzibaka zyonse mucisi cako. Milawo yabo ilindene eyo yabantu bamwi, ambi tababambi milawo yo mwami, ino tacelede kuti mwami abaleke kuti bakale.
Kuti na cilabotezya ku mwami, pamalailili kuti bajaigwe, mponya ndiyopa nsiliva zyili makumi mumanza omulangilizi wenkomo wo mwami.''
Mponya mwami wakabweza nywenywe yakwe okupa Haman mwana wa Hammedatha mu Agagite, mulwani wama Juda.
Mwami wakati kuli Haman, ''Ndiyobana kuti mali apegwa kubantu bako. uyo cita eco coyanda amali ayo.''

Mponya balembi bo mwami bakaitwa mubuzuba buli kumi otutatu mu mwezi wokusanguna, lugwalo lulembidwe zyonse Haman zyakalailila zyakalembwa kubendelezi bezici, abo bali mumasi onse, kubendelezi bezibaka zyabantu zyonse ambi okubendelezi babantu bonse, kumasi onse kwindila mumalembo abo, ambi okubantu bonse kwendelanya omushobo wabo. Lwalilembedwe muzina lyo mwami Xerxes ambi okuvungailwa enywenywe yakwe.

Mangwalo akatolwa amapaso kuzisi zyonse, kuti bajaya, okunyonyona ma Juda bonse, kuzwa kubana kusikila kubapati, bana ambi abanakazi, mubuzuba bomwi-mubuzuba buli kumi otutatu mumwezi wama kumi obile( ngo mwezi wa Adar)-ambi okubweza lubono lwabo.
Ipepa limwi lyolugwalo lwakabikwa kuti lube mulawo muzibaka zyonse. Muzibaka zyonse bakambilizya ku bantu bonse kuti balibambile akambo kubuzuba obu.
Makapaso bakainka mukunomwaya mulumbe wo mwami. Mulumbe wakamwaigwa muzibaka zya Susa zyonse. Mwami o Haman bakakala okunwa, kono cisi ca Susa cakalyangana.
Ino Mordecai nakazizibz zyonse zyakacitika, wakayaula zyibiya zyakwe okuzwata masaka ambi okulibika dota. Wakainka akati kecisi, wakalila okongolola mukunyema.
Wakainka kule mane wakasika kumangililo omolyango wo mwami, kambo takwe walikuzumizigwa kwinka ko kazywete masaka.
mumasi onse, oko mulumbe wo mwami kwasika, kwali kulila kupati akati kama Juda, kabalimywa kulya, kabalila ambi okongolola. Bunji bwabo balalala amasaka kabalibkide dota.
Ino balanganya Esther aba bilesi bakwe nibakamwambila, mwanakazi wo mwami wakanywema. Wakatuma zibaki zyokuti Mordecai akazwate (kutegwa akagwisye masaka ), kono takwe nakazizumina.
Mponya Esther wakaita Hathak, umwi wabapati pati upedwe musebezi wokumubelekela. Wakamutuma kuti ainke kuli Mordecai akavwe zyakacitika okuti zyamba nzyi.
Mponyina Hathak wakainka kuli Mordecai akati kecisi kunembo lyomulyango wo mwami.
Mordecai wakamwambila zyonse zyakacitika kulinguwe, ambi omulo ngwakasyomezya Haman kuti ulapa munkomo wo mwami mumulawo wapedwe kuti ma Juda bonse bajaigwe.
Wakamupa epepa lyalembidwe mu Susa lyomulawo. Wakacita eci kuti Hathak akatondezye Esther, omukuti azibe okwinka ku mwami kuyokombelezya kuluse lyakwe, ambi okukombelezya akati kabantu bakwe.
Mponya Hathak wakainka okwambila Esther ezyo Mordecai zyakamwambila.
Mponyina Esther wakambola Hathak ambi okumwambila kuti apiluke kuli Mordecai.

Wakamba, ''Bonse bazike bo mwami abantu bo mwami mumasi balizi kuti kufumbwa mwalumi na mwanakazi wika ku mwami kataitidwe, kuli mulawo womwi: wokuti ajaigwe-ati oyo mwami ngwazumizya kuzakuli nguwe kutegwa apone. Sizumizidwe kwinka ku mwami kwamazuba ali makumi otatwe.''
Mponya Hathak wakamwambila ntume eyi Mordecai.
Mordecai wakaupilusya mulumbe kuli Esther: ''Utayeyi kuti nokala mun'anda yo mwami ulafutuka ma Juda bakujaigwa.
Kuti na waumunina mulicino cindi, umwi uyofutula ma Juda munzila imbi, kono yebo en'anda yabauso muyopenga. Nguni uzi mwendi bukale bomubwami bwakaza akambo cino cindi?''
Mponyina Esther wakatuma ntume kuli Mordecai,

''Koya, bunganya bonse ma Juda bakala mu Susa, ambi mulimywe kulya akambo kamebo. Mutalyi na kunywa kwamazuba otatwe, masiku na sikati. Babelesi bangu amibo tulacita mbonyina munzila eyi. Mponya ndilainka ku mwami, nokuba kuti tacili mumulawo, mponya kuti ndapenzigwa, ndilapenzigwa.''
Mordecai wakainka okucita eco Esther ncakamubuzya kuti acite.
Nikwakainda mazuba otatwe, Esther wakazwata zibiya zyobwami okwinka kun'anda yo mwami, okuyoima kunembo lyen'anda. Mwami walikede mucibula cobwami mu'anda yakwe, kalangide kumanjililo en'anda.
Ino mwami nakamubona Esther mwanakazi wakwe kaivwi, wakajana luse mumeso akwe. Wakatambika nkoli wakwe yali mumanza. Mponya Esther wakaswena okujata ku nkoli.
Mponya mwami wakamba kulinguwe, ''Uyanda nzi, mwanakazi wangu? Ncoyanda cinzi? busena bobomi na, buyopegwa kuli yebo.''
Esther wakati, ''Kuti na cilamubotezya mwami, leka mwami o Haman baze ku pobwe ndindamubambila.''
Mponya mwami wakati, ''Amumwete Haman mukufwambana, kuti kucitwe eco Esther ncayanda.'' Mponya mwami o Haman bakainka kupobwe elyo Esther ndyakabamba.
Mponya wani niyakabikwa, mwami wakati kuli Esther, '' Ino coyandisya ninzi? Ciyopegwa kuli yebo. Ino uyanda nzi? busena bobwami, ciyopegwa.''
Esther wakataba, ''Buyandisi bwangu nceci,

Kuti na ndajana luse mumeso o mwami ambi na cilamubotezya mwami kuti ndipegwe eco nceyanda ape okucilemeka, Anu mwami o Haman bakaze kupobwe elyo njindababambila junza mponya ndiyomutaba mibuzyo yakwe mwami.''
Hamana wakainka kaboteledwe kumoyo wakwe buzuba obo. Kono Haman nakabona Mordecai amulyango, kuti Mordecai takwe nakanyamuka na kuyowa, wakazonyemena Mordecai.
Nikubabobu, Haman wakalifwinsya okutalitondezya kuti wanyema mponya wakainka kun'anda. Wakainka kubenzinyina okubabunganya, o Zeresh mwanakazi wakwe.
Haman wakabalulula buvwubi bwakwe, mwelwe wabana balumi bakwe, bulumbo mbwakamulumba mwami, mponya ezintu zyakajana kwinda bapati abazike bo mwami.
Haman wakati, ''Esther waita buyo mebo o mwami kupobwe ndyabamba. Ape ejunza ndilainka o mwami.
Kono zyonse ezi zyobuyo kuli mebo kene ndanobona Mordecai kakala amulyongo.''

Mponya Zeresh mwanakazi wakwe wakamba kuli Haman abenzinyina, ''Abapange canda cokujaila cilafu. Bwaca kuseni ukamwambile mwami kuti Mordecai akagilwe pateni. Mponya ukainke kototelidwe kupobwe.'' Eci cakabotezya Haman ambi canda cakapangwa.
Busiku obo mwami takwe nakalala. Wakambila bazike kuti bete bbuku lyamalembe mubulili bwakwe, mponya lyakabalwa ku mwami.
Cakajanya kuti malembe amwi amba kuti Mordecai ngwakatola ntume ya mapaso bobile balikuyanda kujaya mwami Xerxes.
Mwami wakabuzya, ''Ino bulumbu nzi bwakapegwa kuli Mordecai mukucita eci? mponya bazike bomwami bakati, ''Takwe cakacitwa kulinguwe.''
Mwami wakati, ''Ino nguni uli mubuse bokunembo?'' Ino Haman nalikunjila mubusena obo kuti azoambe makani okujaya Mordecai.
Bazike bo mwami bakati kulinguwe, ''Haman nguivwi mubusena obo.'' Mwami wakati, ''Amumuleke asike.''
Mponya Haman nakanjila, mwami wakamubuzya, ''Ino cinzi cinga cacitwa kuli oyo mwami ngwajanina luse?'' Ino Haman wakamba mumoyo wakwe, ''Ino nguni oyo mwami ngwanga wajanina luse winda mebo?''
Haman wakati ku mwami, ''Kumwalumi oyo mwami ngwajanina luse,
amwete zibiya zyobwami, zibiya mwami zyakazyata, ambi embongolo mwami njakatanta kale ambi ejesi zyobwami amutwe.

Mponya zyibiya embongolo zipegwe kuli oyo mwami ngwayanda kupa bulumbu. Mponya azwatigwe zyibiya okutansikwa ambongolo okwezigwa muzibaka. Mponya bambilizye, 'Kuti eci ncecico kumuntu oyo mwami ngwayanda kupabulumbu!'''
Mponya mwami wakati kuli Haman, ''Fwamba, bweza zibiya embongolo, mbuli bwaamba, mponya ucite eci kuli Mordecai oyo ukala amulyango. Utakacilwi nikuba kanini kli ezyo zyuamba.''
Mponya Haman wakabweza zyibiya embongolo. Wakazwatika Mordecai okumwenzenzya mucisi. Wakambilizya, ''Eci ncecico cicitwa kuli oyo mwami ngwayanda kupabulumbu!''
Mordecai wakapiluka kumulyango wo mwami. Kono Haman wakafwambanina kun'anda yakwe, kalila, kavwumbide kumutwe.

Haman wakambila Zeresh mwanakazi wakwe abenzinyina bonse zyakamucitikila. Mponya benzinyina bazibidwe kubosongo, bakamwambila abanakwe Zeresh, kabati, ''Kuti na Mordecai, mu Juda ambi wakalisenda mumeso akwe, toyokonzi kumuzunda, kono uyozundwa.''
Nibalikwambola anguwe, batume bo mwami bakasika. Bakafwambana kumweta Haman kupobwe elyo Esther ndyakabamba.
Mponya mwami o Haman bakainka kupobwe lyabambidwe o Esther.

Muli obu buzuba bwabili, nikwali kunywigwa wani, mwami wakamba kuli Esther, ''Ino uyanda nzi, Esther mwanakazi wangu? Ciyopegwa kuli yebo. Buyandisi bwako ninzi? busena bobuleli bwangu na, ambi ciyopegwa.''
Esther wakataba, ''Kuti na ndajana luse mumeso ako, mwami, ambi kuti na cilakubotezya, bumi bwangu abupegwe kuli me-mbobuyandisi bwangu, ambi ndacikumbila okubantu bangu.
Kambo twauzigwa, mebo abantu bangu, kuti tunyonyonywe, kujaigwa, ambi okugugosigwa. Kambe kuti twakuzigwa buyo mubuzike, mbuli balumi abanakazi bazike, nindaumunina, takwe cinga canywemya mwami.''
Mponya mwami Xerxes wakati kuli Esther, ''Ino ngwan? Ino nguli oyu muntu wetelezya kuti moyo ube amakanze aya?''
Esther wakamba, '' Muntu ngumutaendelani, mulwani, ngoyu Haman mubi!'' Mponya Haman wakayowa akati ko mwami abanakwe.
Mwami wakanyamuka mukunyema okwinka ku gadi, kono Haman wakakala okukombelezya mwanakazi wo mwami Esther. Wakabona kuti cibi cobuza kuzwa ku mwami.

Mponya mwami wakapiluka kuzwa ku gadi okuza kubali kunywida wani. Haman wakazwa akuwa pakede Esther. Mwami wakati, ''Ninga wandicisila mwanakazi wangu mumeso angu mun'anda yangu?'' Mukufwamba fwamba majwi aya nakazwa mukanywa lyo mwami, bazike bakavwumba Haman kumeso.
Mponya Harbona, mupati pati ubelekela mwami, wakati, ''Canda cilafu cipangwe kun'anda ya Haman. Mbuli cakapangila Mordecai, oyo wakambola mukukwabilila mwami.'' Mwami wakati, ''Amumusungile mpawo.''
Mponya bakamusunga mponya papangilide Mordecai. Mponya kunyema ko mwami kwakaza ansi.

Mubuzuba obo mwami Xerxes wakapa Esther lubono lwa Haman, mulwani wama Juda, ambi Mordecai wakatalika kubelekela mwami, kambo Esther wakambila mwami mbubaswenene o Mordecai. Mwami wakagwisya nywenywe wakwe,
eyo njakabweza kuli Haman, ambi okupa Mordecai. Esther wakasala Mordecai kuti abe acibaka ca Haman.
Mponya Esther wakambola o mwami limbi. Wakakonkomeka mukwe ansi okulila nalikukombelezya kuti alube zyonse zibi ezyo Haman zyalikukanza, ku makanze ngakakanzide kuma Juda.
Mponya mwami wakatambika nkoli wakwe kuli Esther, wakanyamuka okwima kunembo wo mwami.

Wakati, ''Kuti na cilamubotela mwami, ambi okuti na ndilajana luse mumeso ako, kuti na zyintu zyiboneka kabotu ku mwami, ambi okuti na ndilamubotezya mumeso akwe, akulembwe lugwalo luzumizya kuti magwalo akalembwa o Haman mwana wa Hammedatha mu Agagite, lugwalo ndwakalemba kuti lunyonyo ma Juda bonse bakede mucisi co mwami.
Ino ninga ndavwa buti kuti zibi kaziza ku bantu bangu? Ino ninga ndakala cindi cilafu buti keeba zibi kubazyalwama?''
Mwami Xerxes wakati kuli Esther o Mordecai mu Juda, ''Langa, Ndapa Esther n'anda ya Haman, ambi bamusunga, kambo walikuyanda kujaya ma Juda.
Lemba lumbi lugwalo lwa ma Juda muzina lyo mwami ambi lujalwe enywenywe yo mwami kambo takwe unga wacibweza.''

Mponya balembi bo mwami bakaitwa aleco cindi, mu mwezi watatu, oyo ngo mwezi wa Sivan, mubuzuba buli makumi obile otutatu. Lugwalo lwakalembwa kwendelanya zyonse Mordecai zyakayanda kuma Juda. Lwakalembwa kubapati pati bezisi, baleli abapati pati bali kuzwa ku India oku Cush, 127 masi, kumushobo omushobo lwalembidwe mumalembo abo, ambi oku bantu bonse mumushobo wabo, ambi okuma Juda mumalembo emishobo wabo.
Mordecai wakalemba muzina lyo mwami Xerxes ambi okulujazya enywe nywe yo mwami. Wakatumizya magwalo ngakapa basimbongolo, mambongolo abelesigwa munkondo, zikomenena mubwami.

Mwami wakapa ma Juda bakala mumasi onse kuzumizigwa kuti babungane antomi okupanga cikonke kuti bapone: Kujaya, okunyonyona kufumbwa balwani bazwa kumasi amwi, kubikilizya bana, abanakazi, nakubweza lubono lwabo.
Eci calikwelede kuba mumasi onse mumwami Xerxes, mumazuba ali kumi otutatu mumwezi wamakumi ali kumi otubili, oyo ngo mwezi wa Adar.
Lugwalo lumwi lwakagwisigwa mbuli mulawo muzisi ambi okulwambilizya kubantu bonse. Ma Juda balilibambilide buzuba obu kuti bapilusizye nkondo kubalwani babo.
Mponya basimambongolo bakabika zibbudu amambongolo abeleka ku mwami. Bakainka kakutakwe kuzumbuzya. Lugwalo lo mwami lwakagwisigwa mane ku Susa.
Mponya Mordecai wakazwa mumeso o mwami kazywete zibiya zyobwami, omuncini we ngolide esila lisalala salala, ambi ecisi ca Susa bakongolo oku kondwa.
Ma Juda balomumuni, okulumba, oluyando.

Muzibaka zyonse omumasi, kufumbwa oko mangwalo o mwami kwakasika, kwalikukondwa okunonenwa akati kama Juda, pobwe amazuba okupumuna. Bantu banji bokule ambabo bakaba ma Juda, kambo kobuyofu bwama Juda.

Ino mumwezi we kumi otubili, oyo ngo mwezi wa Adar, mubuzuba bwa kumi otutatu, awo mulawo wo mwami niwalikuyandika kuti ucililwe, mubuzuba balwani bama Juda nibalikuyeya kuti babazunde kunguzu, cakapilusigwa. Ma Juda bakaba enguzu kwinda abo babasulide.
Bama Juda bakabungana mumasi onse azwede mucibaka ca Xerxes, kuti bajaye bonse abo balikuyanda kweta manyongwe akati kabo. Takwe naba omwi walikukonzya kubakasya, kambo buyofu bwakaza kubantu babo.
Bonse bendelezyi bezibaka, abasololi bezibaka, basololi, ambi abaiminizi bo mwami, bakagwasilizya ma Juda nkambo kobuyofu bwa Mordecai bwakabazida.
Nikuba kuti Mordecai wakali mupati pati mun'anda wo mwami, empuwo wakwe yakavwika muzibaka zyonse, kambo mwalumi oyu Mordecai walikwambwa kuti mupati.
Ma Juda bakalwanya basinkondonyina epanga, kubajaya ambi okubanyonana, ape okucita ezyo zilalikuyanda bonse baabasulide.
Mucisi ca Susa bama Juda bakajaya ambi okunyonyona balumi bali kumi otusanu.
Bakajaya mu Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,
Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,
Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, Vaizatha;
bakajaya abana ba Haman mwana wa Hammedatha bali kumi, mulwani wama Juda. Kono takwe nibakabweza lubono lwabo.
Mubuzuba obo mwelwe wabo bajaidwe mucisi ca Susa, wakambwa ku mwami.

Mwami wakati kuli Esther, ''Ma Juda bajaya bantu basika kumwelwe ili yosanwe mucisi ca Susa, kubikilizya abana balumi ba Haman bali kumi. Ino bacita nzi mucisi co mwami? Ino ncinzi coyanda? Ciyopegwa kuli yebo. Ncoyanda cinzi? Ciyopegwa kuli yebo.''
Esther wakati, ''Kuti na cilamubotela mwami, Leka ma Juda bali mu Susa bapegwe nguzu kuti bacitolelezye sunu mane kusikila junza, ambi muleke mibili yabana ba Haman bali kumi basungwe.''
Mponya mwami wakabambila kuti eci cicitike. Makani amwi akambwa mu Susa, ambi bakasunga bana ba Haman bali kumi.
Ma Juda abo bali mu Susa bakaswangana antomwe mubuzuba buli kumi ecisambomwe mumwezi wa Adar, ambi okujaya balumi bali mwelwe yotatwe mu Susa, kono takwe nibakabweza lubono lwabo.

Bama Juda bonse bakaswangana antomwi kuti baiminine maumi abo, ambi kwakaetelezya kuti bangunuke kuzya kubalwani babo kwindila mukujaya bali mwelwe amakumi balicisambomwe-otusanu abo babasulide, kono takwe nibakabweza nikuba lubono lwabo bakajayigwa.
Eci cakacitika mubuzuba bwamakumi otakwe wo mwezi wa Adar. Mubuzuba bwamakumi one bakapumuna okubupanga kuti bube buzuba bokulimya kulya okulumba.
Kono bama Juda bali ku Susa bakabungana antomwi mumazuba amakumi otatwe ambi amakumi osanwe. Mubuzuba bwasanu bakapumula okubupanga kuti bube buzuba bokulimya kulya okulumba.
Eci ncecico bama Juda beminzi, bayakide manda abo muminzi, mbubalanganya buzuba bwasanu mumwezi wa Adar kuti mbuzuba bokulimya kulya okulumba, ambi kuti mbuzuba mbobapana zipo zyokulya.
Mordecai wakabamba mangwalo antomwi okwatumizya kuma Juda bonse bakala mumasi omwami Xerxes, ali afwifwi okule,
Okubamba buzuba bwane obuzuba bwasanu bomwezi wa Adar myaka yonse.

Aya ngamazuba bama Juda nibalikulemununwa kuzwa kubalwani babo, ambi ngomwezi myoyo yabo niyalikukondwa kuzwa mukubigilwa, ambi kuzwa mubuzuba bokulila kusika mukubotelwa. Bakabamba mazuba ayo kuti ngo kulimya kulya okulumba, ambi okwabanya zilyo akati kabo, ezipo kubacete.
Ino bama Juda bakazwidilila okucita ezyo zibatalikide kucita, ezyo Mordecai zyakabalembela.

Ali eco cindi Haman mwana mwalumi wa Hammadatha mu Agagites, mulwani wama Juda bonse, walamakanze okunyonyona bama Juda bonse, mponya wakasowa Pur (kokuti, wakasowa banji), kuti abasupe okubanyonyona.
Kono makani aya nakasika ku mwami, wakapa malailile amangwalo kuti ezyo zikanzwa o Hamam zimupilukile amutwe wakwe, ambi kuti we abana bakwe bajaingwe.
Mponyina bakaita mazuba aya kuti ngu Purim, kuzwa kuzina lya Pur. Akambo kezyo zyakalembindwe mumangwalo, ezyo zyonse zibakabona ambi ezyo zyakabacitikila,

Bama Juda bakazumina bwendelezi bumbi. Obubwendelezi kabuli bwabo, olunyungu lwabo, ambi oyo yonse ulikulubazu lwabo. Cakabikwa kuti cinoli cindi nibasekelela mumazuba aya obile mu myaka. Banosekelela munzila imbi acindi comwe mu mwaka.

Bakatalika kwasekelela okwayeya mazuba aya kolunyungu olunyungu, mukwashi onse, cisi conse ambi amasena onse. Aya mazuba a Purim tayelede kulubwa akati kama Juda, ambi kuyeyekwabo kutakamani kusikila kulunyungu bwabo.
Esita mwana wo mwami Abihail o Mordecai mu Juda wakalemba mulawo okubamba mumangwalo abili ajatikizya Purim.
Mangwalo akatumwa kumasi ama Juda ali 127 mucisi ca mwami Xerxes,

Mangwalo aya alikwamba mazuba a Purim munako yelede, mbuli Mordecai mu Juda ambi omuleli Esther bakalilela mbuli ma Juda. Bama Juda bakazumina kulilela antomwi olunyungu lwabo, mbuli mbubakazumina kulimya kulya okulumba.
Mwendelezi womuleli wa Esther wakazumina mulawo kwendelanya o Purim, ambi akalembwa mubbuku.
Mponya mwami Xerxes wakabika mulawo wokuti kakubbadelwa mitelo munyika wakwe ambi ezibaka zili munsi olwizi.
Munguzu zyakwe zyonse, antomwi ezyo Mordecai zyakacita zyaketezya kuti mwami amunyamune, zyakalembwa mubbuku lilembwa zyicitika mubuleli bo mwami woku Media o Persia.

Mordecai mu Juda nguwali kucilila mwami Xerxes. Nguwali mupati akati kama Juda ambi wakatondezigwa luse kuzwa kuma Juda nyina, wakayela bukale bwa bantu bakwe ambi wakambola kujatikizya lumuno lwa bantu bakwe
Eli ndijwi lwo Mwami lyakaza kuli Joel mwana mwalumi wa Pethuel.
Amuvwe eci, nobapati, ape muswilizye, nonse nomukala munyika eyi. Sena kuli nizyakacitika ezyi mumazuba enu na mumazuba abensiku?
Amwambile bana benu eci, ape bana benu baambile bana babo, ape bana babo baambile lunyungu lucilila.
Ino mpaso zyuluka zyakainka, impaso zyipati zyalya; ino mpaso zyipati zyainka, impaso zyalya; ape ezyo mpaso ncizyasiya, zyungu zyalya.
Amubuke, nobacakolwa, ape amulile! kulila, nonse nobacakolwa bewani, kambo wani ilwela wakasigwa.
Kambo cisi cakaza munyika yangu, zyinji zyitabalwi. Meno akwe ali mbuli meno omulavwu, ape ulijesi meno ali mbuli mulavwu mwanakazi.
Wakanyonyona munda wangu wobusansa. Wakantyolola ntabi ozyifusa; intabi zyakatuba.
Amulile mbuli nakalindo uzyambalidwe muci saka akambo kolufu lo muyandwa.
Zipo zyeseke ezipo zyokunywa zyakatimbulwa kulinywe kuzwa mu na'nda wo Mwami. Mupaizi, muzike wo Mwami, amulile.
Myunda yakanyongana; inyika ilalila akambo kembuto zyakanyonyonywa. Wani ntya wakayumisigwa; mafuta alatika.
Amulisende, nobalimi, anywibo, nobalimi be wani, kambo kenyaute emisansa. Kambo butebuzi bwemyunda bwanyonyonywa.
Iwani wakakuba ape omusamu wemisansa wakayuma; misamu wemicelo, ape omusamu wamalala, omusamu wemicelo-yonse misamu yomumunda wakayuma. Kambo kukondwa takuciwo kuzwa ku bantu.

Amuzywatike masaka mponya mulile, nywe nobapaizi! amopolole, webo nobabelesi bokucipalilo. Kamuza, amulale mumasaka masiku onse, nobazike ba Leza. Kuzipo kyembuto ezipo zyokunywa zyakajatwa kuzwa kuna'nda ya Leza wenu.
Amupange zuba lyokulimywa kulya, ape mwite mbunga kuti ibungano. Amubunganye bapati bonse bakala munyika omo kuna'nda wo Mwami Leza wenu, mponya mulile ku Mwami.
Zintu zibi zilikucitika mubuzuba! kambo buzuba bwo Mwami bulafwifwi. Mulimbubo kuyoza manyongwe kuzwa ku Mwami.
Nikwatalinsi kuti zilyo zesu zyakamana mumenso esu, ape okukondwa muna'nda ya Leza?
Imbuto zibolela mumuse, mututombo takwe cilimo. ape ezi bikilo zyakawaulwa, kambo mbuto takwe.
Muzinununa no'mbe! milaka yazyo elendenda mukusweka akambo koku wandola bwizu bokulya. Olo mpongo embelele zilikupenga.
Mwami, Ndalilila kuli yebo. Kambo mulilo watenta saka lyo munkanda, ape omulilo watenta misamu yonse yomumyunda.
Ape eno'mbe zyomumunda zililila yebo, kambo tulonga twayuma, ape mulilo watenta saka lyomunkanda.
Lizya lwija lwe mbelele mu Zion, ape ulizye amulundu wangu usalala! Leka bantu bonse bakala omo munyika bayowe, kambo buzuba bwa Mwami bwabuza; masimpe, bulafwifwi.

Mbuzuba buyosya bomundima, buzuba bwamayoba ape okusiya. mbuli mpaso zyamwakila amulundu, mabunga amabunga abalwani abuza. Takwe nikwali mbunga mbuli eyi, ape takwe nikuciyoba, kusika mane kukasike lunyungu lumwi.
Mulilo ulikunyonyona zyonse zili kunembo, ape kufuta kwateni mulilo ulikutenta. Inyika ilimbuli gadeni ya Eden kunembo kwateni, kono kusule kwateni kuli nkanda inyonyondwe. Masimpe, takwe ciyofutuka.
Imbunga yabalwani ili mbuli mahosi, ape azuza mbuli basikwaezya.
Adula econgo mbuli kuti cikocikala cilatala lyomulundu, ape kuvwika mbuli kuti mulilo ulikutenta munda, ape mbuli kuti nimbunga lyabalwani baya kunkondo.
Zyalibonya bantu balanyema ape amenso abo kulacica.
Zizuza mbuli balwani bapati; zilatanta bwanda mbuli balwani; zilendela amwi, ape buswana, ape tazizwi mumulaini.
Takwe olo womwi utonta mwezinyina; zilendela atomwi, njaya mumulaini; zilazunda nkondo kono tazizwi mumulaini.
Zilafwambanina mumasi, zilazuza kubwanda, zilatanta mumanda, ape zilanjila apulungwido mbuli bebbi.
Inyika elazungana kunembo lyabo, ijulu lyayowa, izuba omwezi zyasiya, ape enyenyezi zyaleka kumweka.
Mwami waongololo kunembo lya balwani bakwe, kambo balwani bakwe mbanji; kambo balenguzu, abo basilila malailele akwe. Kambo buzuba bo Mwami mbupati ape mbubi. Nguni unga wacikozya?
''Olo ino''-Mwami mbwamba-''Amupiluke kulime emyoyo yenu yonse. Mukufwambana, lila, ape mulile.''
Amuyaule myoyo yenu noti buyo zyibiya, mponya mupiluke kuli Mwami Leza wenu. Kambo ulabulemu anguzu, amucesye mukunyema ape mujatisyane muluyando ape musosoloke mukwepwa.
Nguni uzi? kuti na ulacica okulekelela, ape ukusiya cileleko musule lyakwe, cipo ce mbuto ape ecipo cokunywa ku Mwami Leza wenu?
Lizya lwija lwe mbelele mu zion, amupange buzuba bokulimya kulya, ape mupange buzuba busalala bokusyangana.
Amubunganye bapati; amubunganye bana aba nini. Amuleke sikukwata azwide anze, ape ukwata.

Amuleke mupaizi, muzike wa Mwami, lila akati kamajililo etempele acipalilo. Amuleke bambe, ''Amubaleke bantu benu, Mwami, ape mutapangi lukono muzintu, kutegwa masi atamusanyi. ino balamba nzi akati kamasi, 'Ino Leza wabo ulikuli?'''
Mponya Mwami; waliyandide okubafwida luse bantu bakwe.
Mwami wakataba bantu bakwe, ''Langa, Ndiyomutuma ape, wani ipya, ape amafuta. Muyokuta azizyo, ape siyomusulaiki akati kamasi.

Ndiyomutalusya kubalwani bokumbo, ape ndiyozigwisya okuzitola kunyika njumu ilikule. Bokusanguna ndiyobatola kunyika lyokulwizi, ape bamwi kujwe. Mibili iyofunduluka, ape ecinuko cibi ciyovwika.'' Masimpe, wacita zintu zipati.
Mutayowi, nyika; amubotelwe okunonenywa, kambo Mwami wayociti zintu zipati.
Mutayowi, nywebo noba nyama bomusaka! kambo nyika yomunkanda eyomena, misamu iyozyala micelo, ape emisamu yemisansa emwi ziyozyala micelo minji.
Amubotelwe, nobantu boku Zion, okukondwa mu Mwami Leza wenu. Kambo uyoita mvula mpati mbuli mbucakambwa okweta tufafalizi twe mvula kulinywe, imvula mpati mbuli cindi.
Awo avulwida kuyozula buyo esenke, ape ezibikilo zyamafuta ziyozula.
''Ndiyo mupilusizya ezyo zyonse zyakaligwa empaso-mpaso zipati, impaso zyibi, ape empaso zyinyonyona-imbunga wabalwani pati njindakatu akati kenu.
Muyolya zinji ape okukuta, okulumbaizya zina lyo Mwami Leza wenu, oyo wacita zibotu akati kenu, ape siyoiti muswabisyi.
Muyoziba kuti ndili akati kabana Isilayeli, ape kuti ndime Mwami Leza wenu, ape takwe umwi, ape takwe nindiyo swabisya bantu bangu.
Ciyosika kuti mane ndikatile muya wangu ku nyama yonse, ape bana benu balumi abanakazi wayo sinsima. Bapati bayolota ziloto; bana basyimani bayobona zilikunembo.
Ape kubabelesi ababelesi banakazi, mumazuba ayo ndiyotila muya wangu.
Ndiyotondezya zyibiliko kujulu anyika, malowa, mulilo, ape omusumpululu wobusi.
Izuba liyosanduka kuba mundima ape mwezi kuba malowa, kakutana kusika buzuba bubi bo Mwami .
Coyoba kuti oyo yonse wita zina lya Mwami uyofutulwa. Kambo amulundu wa Zion oku Jelusalemu kuyoba zila yokuzwida, mbuli Mwami mbwakamba, ape akati kabasikukozya, abo Mwami mbakaita.
Amulange, mumazuba alya enako ilya, ndakupilusizya buzike boku Juda oku Jelusalemu,

ndiyobunganya masi onse, ape okubeta kunyika yoku Jehoshaphat. Ndiyobabeteka bonse kunu, akambo kabantu bangu olunyungu lwa Isilayeli, oyo ngubakatantamuna akati kamasi, ape akambo kokuti bakabanya nyika yangu.
Bakapanga bantu bangu kuba bazike, kucincanya musyiani omuhule, ape okuzya mwanakazi owani kuti bakolwe.
Ino, ninzi wandinywemena mebo, Tyre, Sidon ape ecisi ca Philistia? ino uyondibbadela? nikuba kuti uyondibbela, ndiyokupilusizya mukufwambana.
Kambo wakandibwezela siliva engolide, ape wakandetela zintu zibotu mutempele yako.
Wakauzya bantu boku Juda abo ku Jelusalemu kuma Giliki, mukuti babe kule omunyika yabo.
Langa, ndilabasala, kuzwa kucibaka cimwakabauzya, ape ndiyopilusizya cikoloti.
Ndiyouzya bana benu balumi abanakazi, kwindila amanza abana Juda. Bayobauzya kubana Sabeans, kucisi cilikule, kambo Mwami wamba.''
Amwambile masi: ''Amulibambile kukondo; amubunganye balumi bapati; amubaleke baze afwifwi; amuleke balumi bonse baze kunkondo.
Amume zikekele zyenu kuti zibe masabule entimba zyenu kuti zibe masumo. Amuleke batakwenguzu bambe, 'Ndilidiide.'
Amufwambane kamuza, nonse nomasi ali afwifwi; amubungana antomwi awa. Mwami, eta ansi balwani bapati.
Leka masi alibusye ape okuza kunyika ya Jehoshaphat. Kambo oko ndiyokala okubeteka masi alafwifwi.
Amubike mucibikilo, kambo butebuzi bulafwi. Koza, sina busansa, kambo zipangilo zyawani zilizwide. Zibikilo zyafusuka, kambo bubi bwabo mbupati.''
Kulicongo, conga munyika yobubetezi. Kambo buzuba bwa Mwami buli afwifwi munyika yobubetezi.
Izuba omwezi zyasiya bbi, inyenyezi tazimwekisi.
Mwami uyongolola kuzwa ku Zion, mponya okongololisya kuzwa ku Jelusalemu. Ijulu enyika ziyozungana, kono Mwami uyoba ngomwevule wa bantu bakwe, ape uyoba ciyubilo cobwanda kubantu ba Isilayeli.
''Mponya muyoziba kuti ndime Mwami Leza upona mu Zion, mulundu wangu usalala. Mponya Jelusalemu uyoba usalala, mponya basimwenda tabayokozi kutimbula mumo ape.

Ciyosika mubuzuba obo milundu nuyokunka wani ilwela, tulundu tukunka amalili, tonse tulonga mu Juda tuyokunka amanzi, ape akasensa kamanzi kayokunka kuzwa kuna'nda wo Mwami okutilila nyika ya Shittim.
Ijipiti iyoba nyika itakali bantu, ape Edom iyoba nkanda itakali bantu, akambo kenkondo wakacitwa kubana Juda, kambo bakatila boluwa butakwe cibi munyika yabo.
Kono Juda uyozula ape, mponya Jelusalemu uyozula kulunyungu olu mane kulunyungu luza.
Ndiyobalwanina akambo kobulowa mbundatakalwanina, Kambo Mwami ulapona mu Zion.''
Kubona kwa Obadiah. Mwami wamba eci kwendelanya e Edom: Twakavwa ntume kuzwa ku Mwami ape omutumwa wakatumwa akati kenu mumasi, kamba, ''Amwime! Atwiime tumulwanye munkondo!''
Langa, ndiyokucesya akati kamasi; muyosuligwa loko.
Kulikumusya komoyo wako kwakwenena, nwe nomukala mupako lyebwe, mutwanda twenu; nomwamba mumyoyo wenu, ''Nguni oyo uyondeta ansi ?''
Olo koluka mujulu mbuli sikwaze ape olo civwumbo cako kacili akati kenywenywezi, ndiyokweta ansi kuzwa oko-kokwamba ko Mwami.
Kuti na bebbi baza kuliyebo, kuti na mubbi waza amasiku-ino muyonyonyonwa buti! tabayobbi zinji kwindila mubakozyezya? kuti na basikubunganya misansa baza kuliyebo, tabayobwezi kumaninizya?
Mbuli Esau mbwayonyangwa, zintu zibotu zisisidwe!
Bonse balumi balimucipangano bayomutuma kwinka kumunyinza we nyika. Balumi bbimuvwana bayomusulaka okumulwanya. Abo bakalya cikwa cenu bayomusandukila. Takwe kuvwana akati kabo.
''Ati na tansime mubuzuba''-mbwamba Mwami-''nyonyona balumi boku Edon ape okusika kumulundu wa Esau?
Balumi bapati bayoyowa, Teman, kutegwa mwalumi onse uyojaigwa kuzwa kumulundu wa Esau.
Akambo kenkondo wakacitwa kumuzyalwanyoko Jokobo, muyovwumbwa isoni, ape muyojaigwa.
Mubuzuba mbumuyoima nji, mubuzuba bantu buto nibayotola lubuno lwako, ape amasimasi nibayonjila kumulyango, okusofwazya Jelusalemu, mwali mbuli mbabo.
Kono mutanonenwi akambo kobuzuba bomuzyalwanyoko, mubuzuba nikwacitika zibi, ape mutanonenwi akambo kabantu bomu Juda mumazuba amanyongwe; mutalikumusyi akambo kamakatazyo.
Mutanjili mumilyango ya bantu mumasonko; mutabotelwi mumazuba amasonko mutalangi lubono mumazuba mabi.
Mutaimi akati kezila mukuti mujate bantu, ape mutatoli bacipona mumazuba amanyongwe.
Kambo buzuba bo Mwami bula afwifwi mumasi onse. mbuli mbumwacita, ciyocitwa kulinywebo; zicito zyenu ziyomupilukila amitwe yenu.
Kambo mwakanwa amulundu wangu usalala, mponya masi onse ayozumanana kunwa. Bayonwa okumina ape ciyoba mbuli kuti takwe nibaliwo.
Kono mumulundu wa Zion kuyoba abo bakacija, ape ciyosalala, mponya ina'nda ya Jokobo iyotola zyonse zyabwezidwe.
Ina'nda ya Jokobo iyoba mbuli mulili, ape ena'nda wa Josefa mbuli busi, mponya na'nda ya Esau iyowaka, bayoitenta, ape okumaninizya. Takuyobi nanga omwi upona muna'nda ya Esau, kambo Mwami wacamba.''
Bantu boku Negev bayotola mulundu wa Esau mponya abantu bomunsi bayotola nyika yoku Philistines. Bayotola nyika yoku Ephraim ape enyika yoku Samaliya, ape Benjamin uyotola coku Gilead.
Bantu bana Isilayile bali bazike bazotola nyika yoku Canaan mane kusikila ku Zarephath. Abo boku Jelusalemu, bali mu Sepharad, bayotola masi oku Negev.
Batumwa bayoinka mane kusikila ku mulundu wa Zion kutegwa balele kumulundu wa Esau, ape ecisi ciyoba ca Mwami.
Eli ndibbuku lya buzyale bwa jesu kilisitu,mwana wa Davida, mwana wa Abulahamu.
Abulahamu wali iisi wa Izaka mponya Izaka wali iisi wa Jakobo, ape Jakobo wali iisi Juda ape aba zyalwanyina.
Juda wali iisi wa Pelezi a Zola kuli Tama, Pelesi iisi wa Hezironi, mponya Hezironi wali iisi wa Lamu.
Lamu wali iisi wa Aminadabu, Aminadabu wali iisi wa Nashoni, mponya Nashoni wali iisi wa Salimoni.
Salimoni wali iisi wa Boazi kuli, Boazi wali iisi wa Obedi kuli Lute,, Obedi wali iisi wa jese.
Jese wali iisi wa Davida wali mwami, Davida wali iisi wa Solomoni kumwanakazi wali wa Uliya.
Solomoni wali iisi wa Lehobowamu, Lehobowamu wali iisi wa Abija, Abija iisi wa Asa.
Asa wali iisi wa Jehosyafati, Jehosyafati iiisi wa Jolamu, mponya Jolamu wesiku ya Uziya.
Uziya wali iisi wa Jolamu, Johamu iisi wa Ahazi, Ahazi iisi wa Hezekiya.
Hezekiya wali iisi wa Manase, Manse iisi wa Amoni, mponya Amoni iisi wa Josiya.
Josiya wali sikale waku Jekoniya ape aba zyalwanyina a ciindi eco cakutolwa kwa baisilaeli ku Babuloni.
Ino musule okutolwa ku Babuloni, Jekoniya wakali iisi wa Siyalutiyeli, Siyalutiyeli wali sikale wa Zelubabeli.
Zelubabeli wali iiisi wa Abiyudi, Abiyudi wali iisi wa Eliyakimu, mponya Eliyakimu iisi wa Azo.
Azo wali iisi wa Zadoki, Zadoki iisi wa Akimu mponya Akimu iisi wa Eliyudi.
Eliyudi wali iisi wa Eliyaza iisi wa Mathani, mponya Mathani iisi wa Jakobo.
Jakobo wali iisi wa Josefa mulimi wa maliya banyina jesu utegwa kilisitu.

Ense mazyalani kuzwa kuli Abulahamu kusikila kuli Davida akali kumi ane, mponya kuli Davedi kusikila kuciindi cakutolwa ku Babuloni kwakali mazyalani ali kumi aane mponya kuzoosika kukuzyalwa kwa kilisitu kwakali mazyalwani ali kumi aane.

Kuzyalwa kwa Jesu kilisitu kwaka citika namu mukutobelezya, banyina bakalibulikidwe akwatwe kuli Josefa, mponya kabatana swangana atomwi, kwakajanika kuti Maliya wakalimitide kwindila munguzu zya muuya usalala.
Pele Josefa, mulumi wakwe nikuba kuti wali muntu ululeme, takwe nakayanda kuti amuusye soni, mponya wanda kumuleka mucumwinizi.

Mponya mbwakacili kuyeeya zintu eezi, mungelo wa leza wazoza kulinguwe muciloto akwamba kuti,"Josefa mwana wa Davida, uta yowi kubweza Maliya kuba mwanakazi wako, kaambo eco ca mitide ncomuya uusalala.
Uyozyala mwana mwalumi, mponya uyo mwita zina lya Jesu, nkaambo uyofutula bantu bakwe kuzinyonyono zyabo,
Ëzi zyeense zyakacitika kuti zibe masimpe ezyo mwami nzyakamba kwindila mumusinsimi, kwamba kuti,
Ämubone, musimbi utazi mwalumi uyo mita akuzyala mwana mwalumi, mponya zina lyakwe liyotegwa Imamuweli" eci camba kuti "Leza ulaswibo".
Josefa nakasinsimuka wakati mbubonya mbuli mungelo wa mwami mbwaka mulailila. Mponya wakakwata mwanakazi wakwe.

ino nguli ooyo wakazyalwa mwami wa ba Juda? nkaambo twabona nywnyezi yakwe nkakako twazinda kuzomukomba
Ciindi mwami Helodi nakamvwa eci, wakapenga, abomu Jerusalema benseneni.
Herodi wakabunganya beense ba paizi abalembi, abamayi be mulawo, wakababuzya"kilisitu uyo zyalilwa kuli?"
Bakamwambila kuti ku Betelehemu ya Judeya nkaambo kulilembedwe amusinsimi.
Ïno na Betelehemu, mucisi ca Juda tabaisi bamamanino kubaleli bo mu Juda, pele kuzwa kuliyebo kuzozyalwa mwendelezi uyoembela bantu bangu ba Isilaeli.
Mponya Herodi kumbali wakati balumi basongo akubabuzya ciindi nyenyezi niyakalibonya.
Wakabatuma ku Betelehemu, wakati "kamuya mukamuyandole kabotu mwana, mwakumujana muzondambile kuti amibo ndikainke kuku mukomba.

Kuzwawo nibakamvwa kumwami, bakainka nzila yabo, mponya nyenyezi njibabwene kujwe yakainka kunembo lyabo mane kusikila niyaiminina ji awo mwana munini mpabede.

Muli alya mazuba kwakasika Johani mubapatizi ulakamboka munkanda yoku Judeya, wakati,
Amwempwe, kambo bwami bwakujulu bulafwifwi.'

Bakabizigwa kuli nguwe mumulonga wa Jodani, okwamba zibi.
Ino nakabona ba Falisi aba Saduki banji bayobuza kukubizigwa kulinguwe wakabambila kuti,' nywebo bana bacipile, nguni wakamutondezya kuti mucije kubukali buza?
Amuzyale micelo yo kwempwa kwenikweni.
Mutayeyi kwamba mumoyo yenu kuti, tulijisi Abulahamu mbuli tataesu. Kambo ndamwambila kuti leza ulakonzya kunyampula bana ba Abulahamu kuzwa mumabwe.
Ino sabule lilibikidwe kale kumiyanda yecisamu. Kufumbwa misamu yonse itazyali micelo mbotu ilatemigwa okusowegwa mumulilo.
Mebo ndamubizya amanzi kuti mwempwe. Mponyina oyo uza musule lyangu uli enguzu kwiinda mebo sizumizidwe kunyamuna indyato. Uyomubizya omuya usalala omulilo.
Cipupuluzyo cakwe cili mujanza lyakwe kambo uzosalazya mulamba wakwe ape uzobunganya maila akwe okuatobika mukatobo.
Ino Jesu wakazwida ku Galilaya okusika kumulonga wa Jodani kuti abizigwe kuli Johani.
Johani wakazumanana kumukasya, wakateti,' ndelede kubizigwa kuli yebo, anukuti yebo waza kulimebo?
Jesu wakataba okwamba luinguwe kuti, ' kuzumuzugwa kuli inawa, kambo cibotu kuliswebo kuzuzikuzya kusalala. Mponyina Johani wazumizigwa.
Nakamana kubila, Jesu wakafwambana kuzwa mumanzi, mponyina julu lya kajuka kuli nguwe.
Wakambona muuya wa leza ulaseluka mbuli gwilimba a leza alinguwe.
Ino Jesu wakendelezegwa o muuya munkanda kuti akasunkwe o diabulosi.

Musunki wakasika okwamba kuli nguwe,"na uli mwana o keza, ambila mabwe abe cinkwa,"
Mponyina Jesu wakataba okwamba kulinguwe, "cililembedwe, muntu taponi e cikwa acilike buyo, kufumbwa ijwi lizwa kumolomo wa leza,
Mponyina diabulosi nakamubweza kumutola adolopo lisalala okumubika atala eciluli cecikombelo,
okwamba kulinguwe, nauli mwana o leza ulifuse asi, kulilembedwe, ulambila bangelo balakubamba kabotu; ape balakunyamuna mumaza abo, kuti utalicisi zituta a mabwe.
Jesu wakamwambila kuti,"Ape cililembedwe utasunki Jehova leza wako."

Wakamba kulinguwe,"zyoonse zintu ezi ndilakupa, kuti ufugame ansi okundikomba mebo.
Lino jesu wakamwambila,"koya oko kule satani! kambo kuli lembebwe, komba Jehova leza wako, ape ukombe guwe alike.

Ino diabulosi nakamusiya, mponyina, bagelo bakaza okumukomba.

Wakajula mulomo wakwe oku bayisya, kuti,
''Balilelekidwe bapengide mumuya, kambo bwami boku julu mbubwabo.

Balilelekidwe abo babombe, kambo bayo vuba nyika.

''Ndinywe munyo we nyika. Kuti na munyo wasampuka, ino ape ninga waba buti munyo? Taucikwe mulimo ulasoigwa oku lyatokwa amaulu abantu.
Ndinywe mumuni we nyika. Munzi uyakidwe atala e cilundu tukonzi kusiswa.
Bantu takwe niba munika lambi okulibika kunsi ecisuwo, kono balibika achimino, ponya lila munikila boonse bali mu ng'anda.
Amuleke mumuni wenu umunike kunembo lya bantu mane kuti ba bone micito yenu mibotu okutembaula Tata wenu uli ku julu.
''Mutayeyi anga ndaza kuzo nyonyona mulawo na basinsimi. Takwe nindakazida kuzozimwaya, kono kuzo yizuzikizya.
Kasimpe ndamwambila kuti mane julu e nyika zikamane, pele takwe kabbala olo kwisya kuyoinda anze o mulawo, mane kusikila zyeense zikazulile.
Ino kufumbwa utyola nuuba munini we milawo eyi okwisya bamwi kucita namu, uyotegwa munini mubwami bo kujulu. Pele kufumbwa uyoubamba oku bayisya, uyoitwa kuti mupati mubwami bo kujulu.
Ndamwambila kuteti ati buyo bululami bwenu bukainde bululami bwa balembi ama Farisi, nimuyonjila mu bwami bo kujulu.
''Mwakamvwa kuti cakambwa kuli mbabo muziindi zyeciindi, 'Utajayi,' ape, 'Kufumbwa ujaya uyoba o buyumu yumu bo lubeta.'

Kono ndamwambila kuti, kufumbwa unyemena muzyalwanyina uyoba o buyumu yumu bo kubetekwa; kufumbwa oyo usampola muzyalwanyina uyoba mu buyumu yumu bwenkuta mpati; ape kufumbwa waamba tegwa, 'Yebo ocifuba!' uyoba obuyumu yumu bo mulilo utazimi.
Ino wanopa cipo chako acipaililo ponya wayeya kuti muzyalwanyoko ulakambo ayibo,
siya cipo chako kunembo lye cipaililo, okwinka. Sanguna mulekelelane omwananyoko, ponya wamana uze okupa cipo cako.

Amuzumizyanye omulwani nyoko muku fwambana nimucili anguwe munzila yoku nkuta, kambo sinkondonyoko ulakonzya kukutola kumubetesi ape mubetesi ulakonzya kukutola kumulindizi, ponya ninga wasowelwa muntolongo.
Nconzyo ndamwambila kuti, takwe noyozwa muya kusikila mane ukabbadele kamali kasyede.
''Mwakamvwa kuti kwakambwa, 'utaciti bumambe.'
Kono ndamwambila kuti kufumbwa ulangisisya amwanakazi oku munyomenena kokuti wacita kale bumambe anguwe mumoyo wakwe.

Kuti na linso lyako lye cilisya likwetelezya kuti ubisye, ligwisye okuli sowa kuzwa kuli yebo. Kambo kubotu kuli nywebo kuti cibela comwi comubili wenu cha nyonyoka kwinda kuti mubili wako woonse uka sowelwe mumulilo utazimi.
Kuti na janza lyako lyecilisya likwetelezya kuti ubisye, litimbule lizwe kuli yebo. Kambo kubotu kuli yebo kuti cibela comubili comwi chanyonyoka kwinda kuti mubili woonse ukainke mu mulilo utazumi.
Ape calinonga cambwa kuti, 'Kufumbwa utanda mwanakazi wakwe, welede kumupa lugwalo lokumuleka.'
Kono ndamwambila kuti kufumbwa uleka mwanakazi wakwe, watacita bumambe, nkokuti wamucita bumambe. Kufumbwa umukwata kali wakalekwa kokuti wacita bumambe.
''Ape, mwakamvwa kuti cakambwa muciindi cabensiku besu, 'Utakonki cikonke co bubeji, pele ucitile Leza mbuli mwakonka.'
Kono ndamwambila, utakonki nikuba kanini, nokuba kujulu, kambo ce cibbula ca Leza;
nokuba ansi, kambo ce cilyatilo ca maulu akwe; nanga ku Jerusalema, kambo ngo munzi O Mwami mupati.
Nokuba kukonka omutwe wako, kambo tokonzi kusandula kasusu kuti katube na kasiye.
Pele kwamba kwenu akube 'Iyi, iyi,' na 'nee, nee.' Kufumbwa cindilila kuzwa ali eci cizwa ku mubi.
''Mwakamvwa cakambwa kuti, 'Linso ku linso, ape E lino ku lino.'
Ino ndamwambila kuti, mutapilusyi cibi ku mubi. Pele, kufumbwa oyo ukuma kutama lyo lulyo musandwide limwi ape.
Kuti na umwi uyanda ku kuzingila nkani okukunyanga cibaki cako, umuleke atolelezye e jansi lyako.
Kufumbwa ukusongelezya kwenda musinzo we maile lyomwi, inka anguwe ma maile obile.
Amupe kufumbwa kuli oyo umukumbila, ape mutafutatili kuli umwi uyanda kukolota kuli yebo.
''Mwakamvwa cakambwa kuti, 'Welede kuyanda mwenzinyoko oku sula mulwaninyoko.'
Pele ndamwambila kuti, yanda mulwaninyoko oku bakombela abo bakupenzya, leleka bakutuka, oku bacitila zibotu abo baku sula,
kutegwa mube bana ba Uso uli kujulu. Kambo inguwe ngucita kuti zuba lizwide babi ababotu, okutuma mvula ababotu ababi.
Nkambo kuti mwayanda abo bamuyanda, ino mujana mpindu nzi? Kokuteti abo basimitelo tabaciti cintu comwi na?
Ape kuti kamulumelesya buyo bazyalwanyoko, cinzi cimucita kwinda bamwi? Basimasi tabaciti cintu comwi na?
Mpoonya nywebo mwelede kusalala moonya mbuli Uso uli kujulu mbwasalala.
''Amucenjele kuti mutaciti milimo yenu iluleme kubantu kuti bamubone, kambo mwacita namu tamuyobi empindu kuzwa kuli Uso wenu uli kujulu.

Ciindi nimupa zipo zyoluzyalo, mutalizyi mpeta kunembo lyenu mbuli basi kupaupa amenso mbubacita mu ma sinagogi omu tuzila- zila, kuti balumbaizigwe abantu. Nconzyo ndamwambila kuti, batambula kale mpindu zyabo.
Pele nimupa zipo zyoluzyalo, mutazumizyi janza lyenu lyecigoyo kuti lizibe lye cilisya cili likucita
kutegwa zipo zyenu zipegwe mu kusisikizya. Ponya Uso ubona mu kusisikizya uyomupa bulumbu.
''Mwanokomba, mutabi anga mba sikupaupa, kambo balayanda kwiima oku komba muma sinagogi omu migwagwa mipati kutegwa babonwe abantu. Kasimpe ndamwambila nywebo, balitambwide kale mpindu yabo.
Kono nywebo, mwanokomba, amunjile mung'anda yenu mukati. Mujale mulyango okukomba kuli Uso, utabonwi. Mponya Uso ubona zyo mukusisikizya uyo mulumbula.
Mwanokomba, mutapangi bwinduluzi butabeleki mbuli mu bacita Basimasi, kambo bayeya anga bayomvwigwa akambo ka majwi abo manji.
Ino, mutabi anga mbabo, kambo Uso ulizi zintu nzimuyanda kamutano mukumbila.
Ino amukombe namu: 'Tata wesu uli kujulu, izina lyako ali kutekwe mbuli mbuli salala.
Bwami bwako abusike. Luyando lwako alucitwe ansi ano mbuli mulubede kujulu.
Utupe sunu cilyo co buzuba o buzuba.
Utulekelele milandu yesu, mbuli mutu balekelela bale milandu kuli swebo.
Utatutoli muku sukusigwa, pele utugwisye ku mubi. Kambo Bwami mbubwako, enguzu obulemu, mane kukabe kutamani.'
Kuti na mwalekelela bantu bulubizi bwabo, Uso wenu uli kujulu anguwe uyo mulekelela.
Pele kuti na nywebo tamubalekeleli bulubizi bwabo, anguwe Uso wenu uli kujulu takoyomulekelela bulubizi bwenu.

''Nimulimya kulya, mutano lilengwani kumenso mbuli ba sikupaupa mbubacita, kambo bala litengwanya kumenso abo kutegwa baboneke ku bantu kuti balimya kulya. Kasimpe ndamwambila, balijene kale bulumbu bwabo.
Pele nywebo, nimulimya kulya, munanike mutwe wenu okusamba ku menso
kutegwa kutaboneki kuli bamwi kuti muli kulimya kulya, pele ati buyo kuli Uso utabonwi; ape Uso wenu ubonena mukusisikizya uyo mulumbula.
''Mutabambi lubono ansi, awo mapempe O bulala mpuzinyonyona, abebbi mpuba donkola okubba.
Pele, amubambe lubono lwenu kujulu, oko mapempe nekuba bulala nku zitakonzi kunyonyona, ape abebbi kuba takonzi ku donkola okubba.
Kambo oko kuli lubono lwenu, O moyo wenu nkwatunobede.
Linso ndye lambi lyo mubili. Mponya, kuti na linso lyako lili kabotu, mubili wense uzwide mumuni.
Kono kuti na linso lyako ndibi, mubili wense uzwide mudima. Ino, kuti na mumuni oyo uli muli nywebo uzwide mudima, mupati oyo mudima!
Takwe muntu ukonzya kubelekela basimalelo bobile, kambo ulasula umwi okuyanda umwi, Na ulajatilila kuli umwi oku sansola umwi. Tokonzi kubelekela Leza O lubono.
Mponya awo ndamwambila, mutabilaili obuumi bwenu, kuti muyolya nzi na muyonywa nzi; na zyomubili wenu, zimuyo zwata. Nkokuti buumi tabwiindi cokulya, omubili kwiinda zizwato?
Amulange bayuni muluwo. Tababyali ape tabatebuli nokuba kubamba mu tutombo, kono Uso wenu uli kujulu ulabapa cokulya. Nkokuti nywebo tamuyandiki kwinda mbabo mbubabede na?
Ino ngwani wenu ubilaila ukonzya kuyungizizya ciimo ku buumi bwakwe?
Kambo nzi nimubilaila zyokuzwata? Amuyeye maluba-luba omusaka, mbwakomena. Tabeleki, ape tasumi zizwato.
Pele ndamwambila, nikuba Solomoni mubulemu bwakwe takwe nakazwatikwa mbuli ngayo.
Pele kuti na Leza ulazwatika bwizu musaka, bunga sunu mpubuli junza bwasowelwa muciko, ino mbuti kwiinda mbwayo muzwatika nywebo, nywebo noba silushoomo lunini?
Ino mutabi nimubilaila okwamba ati, 'Ino tuyolya nzi?' na 'Tuyonwa nzi?' na 'Zibiya nzi zituyozwata?'
Kambo ambabo Basimasi balaziyandola zintu ezi, awe Uso wenu uli kujulu ulizi kuti mulaziyanda.
Pele amusangune kuyandola bwami bwakwe obululami, pawo zintu ezi zyonse ziyopegwa kuli nywebo.
Pawo, mutabi nimubilaila zye junza, kambo bwe junza buyoli bilailila. Buzuba buli bwense buli jesi mapenzi ayo.
''Utabeteki, kutegwa ayibo utakabetekwi.
Kambo kokubeteka ko beteka, ayibo uyobetekwa, echipimo chopimya, ayibo chiyokupima.
Kambo nzi nolanga kakwaa kali mulinso lyo muzyalwa nyoko, kono toyeyi tanda lili mulinso lyako?
Inga wamba buti ku muzyalwa nyoko, 'Andiku gwisye kakwaa kali muli linso lyako,' kakuli tanda lili mulinso lyako?
Yebo osikupaupa! Sanguna kugwisya tanda mulinso lyako, pawo uyobona kabotu kugwisya kakwaa kali mulinso lyo muzyalwa nyoko.
Utapi echo cisalala ku babwa, ape tamwelede kusowa nsasiko zyenu kunembo lye ngulube. Kambo inga zyalya tokwa buyo, okukusandukila ponya kuku yawola muzipanzi.
''Kumbila, pawo uyopegwa. Yandola, ape uyojana. Konkota, pawo uyojulilwa.
Kuli woonse ukumbila, ulatambula; uli woonse uyandola, ulajana; oku muntu ukonkota, uyo julilwa.
Na nguni wenu, kuti mwana akwe mwalumi wakumbila cinkwa, ulamupa bbwe?
Na kuti wakumbila nswi, ulamupa nzoka?
Ino, kuti nywebo nobantu babi mulizi kupa zipo zibotu kubana benu, ino chilainda buti kuli Tata oku julu kupa zintu zibotu kuli abo bamukumbila?
Kokuti anu, kufumbwa zintu zimuyanda kuti bantu bamuchitile, mwelede kubachitila zizyo anywibo, kambo oyu ngo mulawo aba sinsimi.
''Njila mukalyango kamanikide. Kambo mulyango uli kwankwamukide, E nzila nimpati itola ku kunyonyoka, pawo mbanji bantu bainda muli njiyo.
Pele mulyango ulisyanikide e nzila niyumu itola ku buumi, pawo mbache baijana.
''Amuchenjele aba sinsimi bobubeji, abo baza kuli nywebo muzibiya zye mbelele kakuli mukasimpe mbanyama bomusaka.
Mumichelo yabo muyo baziba. Ino bantu ninga bajana misansa kuzwa kuciteyo chobumvwa na nkuyu kuzwa ku mutube-tube?
Munzila njonya, musamu mubotu uzyala michelo mibotu, pele musamu mubi awe uzyala michelo mibi.
Musamu mubotu taukonzi kuzyala muchelo mubi, nokuba musamu mubi nukonzya kuzyala muchelo mubotu.
Kufumbwa musamu utazyali muchelo mubotu ula temwa okusowelwa mu mulilo.
Pele ino, muyobaziba kwindila mumichelo yabo.
Tainsi bonse bamba kuli mebo kuti, 'Mwami, Mwami,' bayonjila mubwami boku julu, kono buyo abo bacita luyando lwa Tata uli ku julu.
Bantu banji bayoti kuli mebo mubuzuba buya, 'Mwami, Mwami, takwe nitwaka sinsima muzina lyako, muzina lyako twakatanda madaimona, ape muzina lyako twakacita milimo mipati?'
Ponya cha ntangalala ndiyobambila, 'Takwe nindamwizi! Amuzwe kuli mebo, nywebo noba simucita zibi!'
''Ino, woonse umvwa majwi angu okwa chilila uyoba mbuli muntu musongo uyaka ng'anda yakwe atala E bbwe.
Imvula yakaza, chilobe chakasika, E guwo lyaka bbubbula okuyuma ng'anda ilya, kono takwe niyakawa ansi, kambo yayakilidwe a bbwe.
Pele kuli oyo umvwa majwi angu kata chilili uyoba anga mwalumi mufuba wakayaka ng'anda yakwe musese.
Imvula yakawa, chilobe cakasika, E guwo lyaka bbubbula okuyuma ng'anda, pawo yakawa, ponya mamanino ayo ali mabi.''
Chakasika ciindi Jesu nakamana kwambola majwi aya, mbunga yabantu yaka komokwa kukwisya kwakwe,
kambo wali kubaisya mbuli umwi wajesi nguzu, kwiinda balembi babo.
Ino Jesu naka seluka kuzwa ku cilundu, mbunga ya bantu yaka muchilila.
Pawo, sichisenda wakaza kuli nguwe oku mukontamina kunembo lyakwe, kateti, ''Mwami, kuti na ulayanda, ninga wandisalazya.''
Jesu waka vungununa janza lyakwe oku mujata, kamba kuteti, ''Ndilayanda. Salala.'' Muciindi ciya conya wakasalazigwa ku chinsenda cakwe.
Jesu wakateti kuli nguwe, ''Bona kuti utambili muntu naba omwi. Koya munzila yako, ukalitondezye ku mupaizi, okuyopa cipego eco Mozesi chaka lailila, cikabe citondezyo kuli mbabo.''
Nali kunjila mu Kapenaume, sikalumamba mupati wakaza kuli nguwe, kamukumbila
okuti, ''Mwami, mubelesi wangu ulilede ku ng'anda uli yuminide kali mucimo chicisa.''
Mponya Jesu wakateti kuli nguwe, ''Ndilaza kuzo muponya.''
Silumamba mupati wakataba okuti, ''Mwami, tandelede kuti yebo ukasike mu ng'anda yangu. Amba buyo jwi ponya muzike wangu ulapona.

Kambo amibo ndili mwalumi wakatondekwa o mulawo, ndili jesi basilumamba bali kunsi lyangu. Ndilamba kuli umwi, 'Koya,' ponya wainka ape okulumwi, 'Koza,' ponya waza, oku bazike bangu, 'Cita echi,' ponya wachicita.''
Ino Jesu nakamvwa buyo echi, waka komokwa okwamba kuli baya boko bumuchilila, ''Kasimpe ndamwambila, takwe nindaka jana muntu ujesi lushomo lubede namu mu Izirael.
Ndamwambila, banji bayooza kuzwa kujwe okumbo, bayo kala a tabule O Abrahamu, Izeki O Jakobo mu bwami bokujulu.
Pele bana bo mubwami bayo sowelwa anze mumudima, oko kunoli kulila okulumanya meno.''
Jesu wakambila silumamba mupati, ''Koya! Mbuli mwashoma, achi kucitikile.'' Ponya muzike wakapona mu woola liya ndyonya.
Jesu nakasika ku ng'anda ya Petro, wakabona bapongozi ba Petro ka balede kuciswa omubili kupya.
Jesu wakajata janza lyabo, ponya baka pona. Pawo baka buka okutalika kubabila zilyo.
Nikwaka jolezya, bantu baketa banji bajesi madaimona. Wakaitanda myuuya mibi e jwi okuponya boonse bacisidwe.
Kwindila omu chakazulila echo chakambwa o musinsimi Izaya, kwamba kuti, ''We lwakwe mweni wakabweza kuciswa kwesu okunyamuna malwazi esu.''
Ino Jesu nakabona mbunga yamuzyungulukide, wakapa malailile okuzwa kwinka kulu bazu lumbi lo lwizi lwa Galile.
Pawo mulembi wakaza kuli nguwe okwamba ati, ''Mwiiyi, Ndilakuchilila kufumbwa koinka.''
Jesu wakateti kuli nguwe, ''Bamwaba bali jesi zigodi, otuto tuyuni to mujulu tulijesi zivumbo, kono Mwana O Muntu tajesi koku yamika mutwe wakwe.''
Umwi wabasikwiya wakateti kuli nguwe, ''Omwami, ndizumizye kuti ndinke ndikasangune kuzika batate.''
Kono Jesu wakati kuli nguwe, ''Ndichilile, pele usiye bafu bazike bafu babo.''
Ino Jesu nakanjila mumugolo, basikwiya bakwe bakamuchilila muli mbubo.
Amulange, kwakaza guwo pati alwizi, kusikila mugolo wakavumbwa amaiwe. Kono Jesu walilede.
Basikwiya bakamuzida okumubusya, kabateti, ''Tuvune swebo, Mwami; tulafwa!''
Jesu wakabambila, ''Muyowa nzi, nywebo nobasilushomo lunini?'' Pawo waka nyamuka oku patokila guwo olwizi. Ponya kwakaba lumuno lupati.
Balumi bakakomokwa okwamba kuti, ''Ino mwalumi uli buti oyu, kuti mane guwo olwizi zilamumvwida?''

Ino Jesu nakasika kulu bazu lumwi oku cisi cha ba Gadareni, balumi bobile banjilidwe madaimona baka muswana. Bali kobuzwida mu mabita kabali obukali, kutegwa takwe simwinda nzila welede kwinda ilya nzila.
Amulange, bakongolola okuti, ''Ino tuchite nzi ayibo, Mwana a Leza? Waza kuzotupenzya ciindi ka chitana ku sika?''
Ino kwali mbunga ye ngulube yali kuchelela kuko, kutainsi kule ambabo.
Madaimona aka kumbila kuli Jesu okuti, ''Watunda, ututandile mumbunga ilya ye ngulube.''
Jesu wakateti, ''Koya!'' Madaimona akazwa okuyonjila mungulube; pawo, ngulube zyoonse zyaka cija okuselela kuzwa aka lundu okuyonjila mulwizi ponya zyakafwa mumanzi.
Baya bali kwembela ngulube bakazuza okwinka mu munzi kuyoamba zyoonse, mane echo chakacitika ku balumi banjilidwe madaimona.
Amulange, munzi woonse wakaza kuzo swana Jesu. Nibakamubona, baka mukumbila kuti azwe mu busena bwabo.
Jesu wakanjila mubwato, wakazubuka,mponya wakainka mumunzi wokuli mbabo.
Mponya, bakamwetela mwalumi ulivukide kalede alusasa. Mukubona lushomo lwabo, jesu wakati kumwalumi ulivukide,"mwanangu,uma. Zibi zyako zyalekelelwa."
Mponya, bamwi balembi bakalyambozya mulicabo,"oyo mwalumi ulimukusampola."
Jesu walizi zibalikuyeya wakati,"ninzi nimuyeya bubi myoyo yenu?
Ino ncecili cubauba, kwambakuti, zibi zyako zyalekelelwa, nanga kwambakuti,nyamuka wende?
Pele mulizi kuti mwana omuntu ulijisi nguzu munyika zyokulekelela zibi,"wakati kuli sikulivuka mubili,"nyamuka,bwezalusasa lwako, mponya winke kuganda yako.
Mponya mwalumi wakanyamuka wakainka kuganda yakwe.
Imbungano yabantu niyakabona eci, bakayowa bakalumbaizya leza, wakapanguzu zili namuya kubantu.
Ino Jesu nakainda awo wakabona mwalumi utegwa Mateyo ulikede atente lyakwe lyecitezezyo. Wakati kulinguwe,"ndicilila."wakanyamuka mponya wakamucilila.
Ino jesu nakakala ansi kuti alye munganda, mponya basimitelo banji abasizibi bakasika okulalila o jesu abasikwiya bakwe.
Mponya bafalisi nibakabona, bakati kuli basikwiya bakwe,"nkambo nzi mufundisi wenu nalya abasimitelo nape abasizibi?
Mponya jesu nakamvwa namuya, wakati"bantu bayumu mumubili takwe nebayanda musilisi, pele buyo abo baciswa.

Mwelelede kwinka mukaiye ncicamba eci: 'ndiyanda luse kutainsi cipaizyo.' nkambo takwe nindakazide kwita baluleme kuti balilekelele pele abasizibi "Mponya basikwiya ba Joni bakaza kulinguwe bakati, "nkambo nzi swebo abafalisi ncitulimya kulya, pele basikwiya bako tabalimyi?" Jesu wakainka muminzi o mutunzi. Wakazumanana kwisya mu ma sinagogo, kukambauka mulumbe o bwami okuponya malwazi amaciswe ense aindene indene.

Bakabisizigwa anguwe. Pele Jesu wakateti kulimbabo,'musinsimi tainsi kuti ujana buyo bulemu nucisi cokulibo ompazwa,
Takwe nakacita malele manji omo nkambo ko kutashoma kwabo.

Kambo Helodi wakajesi Joni, okwetelezya kuti abikwe muntolongo akambo kaba Helodiyasi, banakwe Filipo muzyalwanyina.

Mwami wakanyema kuli echo cakakumbila, pele akambo kakukonka ape akambo kabantu balikulya ambabo chilyo chakujolezya wakazumizya kuti cicitike.
Wakabatuma kuyomutimbula mutwe Joni muntolongo.
Mponya mutwe wakwe waketwa andido akupa musimbi, mponya wakatola kulibanyina.
Mponya basikwiya bakwe bakasika akutola mubili mponya akuyozika. Nikwakamana bakayinka kuyo ambila Jesu.
Awo Jesu nakamvwa namu wakapiluka katana kunjila mubwato akwinka kuchibaka chisololokide. Imbunga niyakamvwa namu, yakauchilila amawulu kuzwa muminzi.
Mponya Jesu wakasanguna kusika kabatana pele wakabona bunji bembunga. Wakabafwida luse ape okuponya malwazi abo.
Nikwakasika kujolezya basikwiya bakasika kulinguwe okwamba, " ecci cibaka citakali bantu, ape eciindi cainka, mwayisya mbunga, kutegwa bakonzye kuyinka muminzi kuyowula zilyo zyabo."
Pele Jesu wakabambila, " Tabayelede kwinka kumbi. Amube cimwi cintu balye." Bakamba kulinguwe," Tulijesi awa zinkwa zyosanwe answi zyobile." Jesu wakati, " Amuzyete kulime."

Mponya Jesu wakambila mbunga kukala ansi abwizu. Wakabwezya zinkwa zilizyosanwe answi zyobile. Wakalanga kujulu, wakaleleka akukomona zinkwa ape akuzipa basikwiya basikwiya pele basikwiya bakazipa kumbunga.
Boonse bakalya akukuta. Mponya bakabweza zilyo zyakasyala - kumi atobile twazisangwa zizwide.

Mponya wakalayilila basikwiya bakwe kunjilamubwato okwinka anembo lyakwe kucibaka cimwi, nakali kumwayisya mbunga.
Nakamana kumwayisya mbunga wakainka atala ecilundu kuyokomba.
Nikwakasika kujolezya wakali alike. Pele bwato bwalale kuzwa anyika, mukutontwa amayuwe, akambo kaluwo lwakali kunga kulimbabo.
Kubucedo Jesu wakswena kulimbabo kabwenda alwizi.
Basikwiya nibakamubona kayenda alwizi bakayowa akwamba, " Ndisako," Mponya bakalila maningi mukuyowa.

Pita wakamutaba mukuti, " Mwami, na ndiwe ndambile kuti ndize okuliyebo amanzi."
Jesu wakati, " Koza." Mponya Pita wakazwa mubwato okwenda amanzi kayabuya kuliJesu.

Mponya Jesu aPita nibakayinka mubwato, luwo lwakayima.
Mponya basikwiya bakamukomba Jesu okuti, " Masimpe ulimwana waLeza."
Nibakazubuka bakayinka kunyika Genesaleti.
Mponya balumi bokucibaka eco nibakamuziba Jesu, bakatuma mulumbe kuzibaka zyafwi okumwetela boonse bacisidwe.
Bakamukumbila kuti ingabajata kumamanino acibiya cakwe,ape mubunji bakajata bakaponisigwa.
Mponya ba Falisi abalembi bakasika kuli Jesu kuzwa ku Jelusalema. Bakati, ''
Ino ninzi basikwiya bako nibadula milawo yabapati? tabasambi kumanza abo banolya cikwa. ''
Wakataba okuba ambila '' ino nizi nimudula mulawo wa Leza. Kambo kotu nsiya nsiya twenu? ''
Kambo Leza wakamba kuti, ' kuteka bauso abanyoko,' pele ' oyo uyo ambola zibi ali baisi na banyina masimpe ulafwa.'
Pele nywebo mulamba kuti kufumbwa wambila baisi na banyina, '' kufumbwa lugwasyo ndomwalukede kutambula kuli mebo ino cipegwa Leza,''
Oyo muntu tayelede kukuteka baisi.' muli eyo nzila mubyaubya ijwi lya Leza.
Nobasikupa upa amenso! mumumo Izaya wakasisima mbomubede wakamba kuti,
Aba bantu balandikuteka emilomo yabo, kono myo yabo ilikule amibo.
Kundikomba kwabo kwabuyo kambo bayisya njisyo zyabo kili milawo yabantu.''
Mponya wakaita bantu bonse kulinguwe okubambila kuti, '' amuswilizye okuvwisisya.''
Takwe cijila mukanwa cisofwazya muntu. Kono, cizwa mukanwa, eco ncecico cisofwazya muntu.''
Mponya basikwiya bakaza okumwambila Jesu, '' ulizi kuti baFalisi bakabijilwa nibakavwa aka kambo? ''
Jesu wakataba okwamba kuti, '' kufumbwa cisyango ba tata bokujulu cibatakabyala cizomunkolwa.
Amubaleke buyo, bendelezi bofu. Kuti muntu mofu wendelezya mofu nyina, bonse balawida mudindi.''
Petulo wakataba okwamba kuli Jesu, '' pandulula aka kambwiyo kuli swebo. ''
Jesu wakati, '' anwibo tamuna kuvwisisya?
Tamuzi kuti kufumbwa cinjila mukanwa cinka mwida mponya ciyo zwida anze?
Kono zintu ziwa mukanwa ziwa mumuyo . Nzezizo zintu zisofwazwa muntu.
Kambo mumoyo muzwa mizezo mibi, bujayi, bumambe, bwamu, bwibi, bumboni bobubeji obuvwuzi. Ezi nzezintu zisofwazya muntu.
Pele kulya amanza atasambide tacisofwazi muntu.''
Mponya Jesu nakazwa oko wakainka kuzisi zya Taya a Sidoni.
Amulange ,mwanakazi wa Kenani wakazwa kucisi eco . Wakaongolola okwamba kuti , '' ndifwide luzyalo, mwami, mwana wa Davida! mwana wangu musimbi unjilidwe myuuya mibi minji. ''
Pele Jesu takwe nakataba oyo mwanakazi nenga jwi lyomwi. Basikwiya bakwe bakaza okumukumbila, bakati, mutande kambo ulimukutusabila.
Mponya Jesu wakataba okwamba kuti, '' nsikatumidwe kumuntu onse pele kumbelele ziswekidwe zyomukowa wa Isilayeli.''
Mponya mewanakazi wakaza okufungamina, okuti, ''mwami, ndigwasye. ''
Wakataba akwamba kuti, '' tainsi cibotu kubweja insima yabana okwifusila tubwa tunini.
Wakati, '' iiyi, mwami, kambo tubwa tulalya tufwefwelenga tuloka kuzwa kumatebule abasimalele ato.''
Mponya Jesu wakataba okwamba kulinguwe, '' mwanakazi, lusyomo lwako ndupati, akucitwe kuli yebo bubonya mbilimboyanda. '' Mwana wakwe musimbi wakapona cindi nconya.
Jesu wakazwa kucibaka oko okwinka kumbali olwizi loku Galilaya. Mponya wakatanta acilundu okukala kwateni.
Bantu bnji bakaza kulinguwe. Bakamwetela zilema, bofu, basyatambi, batyokide, abamwi banji baciside. Bakabatula munsi maulu a Jesu, mponya wakabaponya.
Mponya nkamu yabantu yakakondwa niyakabona bantu basyatambi bambola, zilema zyapona, batyokide benda abofu babona. Bakamulumbaizya mwami wa Isilayili.

Mponya Jesu wakambila bantu boonse kuti bakale ansi.
Wakabweza zinkwa zyosanwe ezibili enswi, nakamana kulumba, wakazikomauna zinkwa okuzipa basikwiya bakwe. Basikwiya bakazipa bantu.
Bantu bonse bakalya okukuta. Mponya bufwefwelenge mbwakasyala bakazuzya masuwo osanwe aobile.
Abo bakalya bali myulu yone balumi, katabala banakazi abanini.
Mponya Jesu wakamwaisya makamu wakanjila mubwato okwinka kucisi coku Magadani.
Bama farisi aba saduki bakaza abatondezye citodezyo cizwa kujulu.
Kono wakataba okwamba kuti kulibabo,"kuti na lya jolezya, mwamba kuti, bulaca kabotu, kambo kujulu kusalala.

Bantu besunu basizibi abo sibwamu balayandola citondezyo, kono tabakopegwa citondezyo, kutaba kuti citondezyo, kutamba kuti citondezyo ca Jona. Mponya Jesu wakabasiya oku lanzya kumbi.
Mponya basikwiya nibakasika kutala, bakaluba kubweza cinkwa.
Jesu wakamba kuli mbabo,ämubone akucenjela emimena yama Falisi aba Saduki."

Ino kambonzi tamuzi kuti tainsi cimkwa cindalikwambola kulinwebo? Amubone okucenjela mumena wama Falisi aba Saduki."
Mponya bakamvwisisya kuti tainsi mumena wacikuwa ngwalikubambila kuti ba cenjele, kono kuti bacenjele kwisya kwama Falisi aba Saduki.
Mponya Jesu nakasika kucisi coku Kaisareya Filipi, wakabuzya basikwiya bakwe, wakati, Ino bantu bamba kuti mwana o muntu ngwani?" Bakamba kuti, bamwi bamba kuti ngu Joni mupapatizi, bamwi,
Eliya, mponya bamwi, Jeremiya, na umwi wabasinsimi,"
Wakamba kuli mbabo,"Petulo wakamba kuti, ndimeni?"
Mukutaba, Simomi Petulo wakamba kuti, ndiwe kilisitu, mwana a leza upona.
Jesu wakataba okwamba kuti kulinguwe, ulilelekidwe yebo, Simoni mwana a Jona, kambo tainsi muntu ulya maila wayubulula eci kuli yebo, kono mba tata ba kujulu.
Ndakamba kuliyebo kuti ndiwe Petulo, mponya atala ebwe eli ndizoyaka cikombelo cangu. Milyango yolufu taluzoizundi.
Ndizokupa zijulizyo zyoku bwami bokujulu. Kufumbwa ncotokange ansi ciyoangwa kujulu, ape kufumbwa ncetokangunune ansi ciyoangununwa kujulu.
Mponya Jesu wakambila basikwiya kuti batambili nenga womwi kuti ngu kilisitu.

Kuzwa eco ciindi Jesu wakatalika kwambila basikwiya bakwe kuti welede kwinka ku Jelusalemu, uyo penga zinji kumanza abapati oku bapaizi basimutwe okubalembi, kujaigwa, okuzobusigwa kubumi mubuzuba bwatatu.

Pele Jesu waka cebuka okwambila Petulo kuti, swena oko kusule lyangu, satani! Uli cilebyo kulimebo, kambo kokuti toyeyi zintu zya leza. pele zintu zyobuntu susu.
Mponya Jesu wakamba kuti kulibasikwiya bakwe, na kuli uyanda ku ndicilizya, alimye, abweze cingano cangu, akundicilizya.
Kambo kufumbwa uyanda kuli yobweda bumi bwakwe kambo kangu azobujane.
Ino nimpindinzi njajana muntu kuti wavuba nyika yonse anukuti wanyanzigwa bumi bwakwe?
Kambo mwana o muntu uzoza mubulemu bwaisi abangelo bakwe. Mponya uzobwedezezya muntu o muntu kwindila mbuli kumilimo yakwe.
Nconzyo ndilamba kuliyebo, mpubali bamwi ba imvwi awa batazolumvwi lufu kusikila bazobone mwana o muntu uzo mu bwami bwakwe.
Nakainda mazuba ali musanu akomwi, Jesu wakabweza [ita o Jakobo o Joni muzyalwanyina wabatola atala eci lundu cilamfu abalike.

Jesu nwakataba okwamba kuti,'batasyomi basicinguni bamazuba ano, cindi cilanfu buti cetikale anywibo? mazuba ongayi ngeti kazike moyo wangu kulinyebo? Amumwete kuno kulimebo.

Mponyina basikwiya bakaza kuli Jesu kumbali okwamba kuti,'ini ninzi nitwatakaitanda?

Pele oyu musyobo wa daimona takizwi kunze oku komba okulimya kulya.
Nibakala mu Galilaya. Jesu wakamba kuli basikwya bakwe, mwana o muntu uzo abwa mumaanza abantu.
