Mubuzuba obo tamuyondibuzi cili conse. Kasimpe, kasimpe, ndamwambila, kuti na mwakumbila cili conse kuli tata muzina lyangu, uyomupa.
Kusiikila cino cindi tamuno kumbila cili conse muzina lyangu. Kumbila uyo uyopegwa, kutegwa kunonenwa kwenu kuzuzikizigwe.''
'' Ndakamwambila ezi zintu mumambilambali, pele cindi cilasika netoyomboli kulinwebo mumambilambali, pele ndiyo mwambila mukucisa zya tata.
Mubuzuba obu muyo kumbila muzina lyangu kono tandiambi kuti ndiyo mukombela kuli tata,
kambo tata lyakwe ulamuyanda kambo mwakandiya ape mwaka syoma kuti ndizwa kuli Leza.
Ndizwa kuli tata, ape ndakaza munyika. Ape, ndilasiya nyika ukwinka kuli tata.''
Basikwiya bakwe bakamba kuti, ''bona, ino ulimukwamba mukucisa ape tolikubelesyi mambilambali.
Ino tulizi kuti ulizi zyonsee zintu, ape toyandi nekuba omwi muntu kukubuzya mibuzyo. Akambo kokuti, tulasyoma kuti uzya kuli Leza.''
Jesu wakabataba, '' kokuti mwasyoma na?
Amubone, cindi cilasika, iiyi, ape casika, nimuyo sabalangana, ngwaya kun'yanda yakwe, ape muyondisiya endike. pele tandinsi endike kambo tata uli amibo.
Ndakazyamba ezi zintu kuli nyebo kutegwa mube olumuno mulime. Munyika mujesi mapenzi, pele muyume, kambo ndakazunda nyika.''
Jesu nakamana kwaamba ezi zintu, wakalanga kujulu akwaamba,'tata, cindi casika, lemya mwana wako kutegwa anguwe akulemye.
Mbuli mbwakamupa nguzu kubantu boonse kutegwa akonzye kupa bumi butamani kuli boonse abo mbiwakamupa.
Obu mbumi butamani: kutegwa bakuzibe, kuti ndiwe leza wamasimpe, ape oyo nguwakatuma jesu kilisitu.
Ndakakulemya ansi. Ndakamanisya musebezi ngowakandipa kuti ndicite.
Inawa, tata, ndilemye antomwe ayibo obulumu mondajesi ayibo kaitana kupangwa nyika.
Ndayubununa zina lyako kubantu mbowakandipa kuzwa anyika. Bali bako mponya wakandipa mbabo ape baka bamba majwi ako.
Ino balizi kuti zyonse ezyo zyiwa ndipede zizwa kuliyebo.
Nkamba ndakapa oonse majwi ngiwakandipa. Bakatambula ape masipe balizi kuti ndakazwa kuli yebo, mponya akusyoma kuti wakadituma.
Ndabakombelela. Tandibakombeli nyika yoonse pele kuli abo mbowakandipa, koamba mbibako.
Zyoonse ezyo zyangu ndizyako, ape zyako ndizyangu, ape ndilalumbaizyigwa mulibabo.
Tandiciwo munyika, pele aba bantu bali munyika, ape ndabuza kuli nywebo. Tata usalala, kobakwabilila ambabo muzina lyako kuti abowakandipa kutegwa bakabe omwi mbuli mbotuli omwi.
Nindacili ambabo, ndakabakwabilila muzina lyako, abo bowakandipa. Ndakabakwabilila, ape takwe waka nyonyoka, ati oyo mwana silunyonyono, kutegwa malembe azuzyikizyigwe.
Ino ndabuza kulinywebo, pele ndili mukwamba ezi zyintu munyika kutegwa babe olusangalilo lwangu malembe azuzyikizyigwe.
Ndakabapa jwi lyako, ape inyika yakabasula kaambo tabacinsi benyika, mbuli mbwetainsi wenyika.
Takwe nindakukumbila kuti ubagwisye kuzya munyka pele cilikuliyebo kubacingilizya kubantu babi.
Tabali bamunyika, mbuli mbwetensyi womunyika.
Babike kumbali akaambo kakasimpe. Ijwi lyako kasimpe.
Mbuli mbowakandituma munyika, amibo ndabatuma munyika.
Akaambo kako ndalitatamuna, kutegwa ambabo balitantamune kukasimpe.
Tandikombeleli aba abakike, pele abo bayosyoma mulindime kwiinda mujwi lyabo.
Kutegwa boonse babe omwi, mbuli yebo, tata, ulimulime amibo muliyebo. Ambabo babemuli swebo kutegwa nyika ikasyome kuti wakandi tuma.
Bulemu mbowakandipa, ndakabapa, kutegwa babe omwi, mbuli mbotuli omwi.
Mebo mulimbabo, mponya ambabo mulime-kuti ambabo bafwe mukukamantana luzwidelide kutegwa nyika izyibe kuti wakandituma, ape kuti wakabayanda mbuli mbowaka ndiyanda.
Tata ndiyanda abo mbumwakandipa kuba amibo oko kwebede, ape okuyobona mbulemu bwangu, bulemu mbowakandipa akaambo wakandiyanda nyika taitana kulengwa
Tata usalala, nyika takwe niyakakuzyiba, pele ndilikwizi; ape balizi kuti wakandituma,
Ndakabaisya kuti bazyibe zyina lyako, ape ndiyo baisya kuti lizyibwe tutegwa luyando ndowakandiyanda lube ambabo, ape ndiyoba muli mbabo.
Nakamana Jesu kwamba aya majwi, wakainka abasikwiya bakwe kulubazu uwmi lwamumpata wakidoni, kwakali kaunda omo inguwe abasikwiya bakwe mubakajila.
Ino Judasi, oyo walikuyoelede kuyomwamba, wakalicizi cibaka, kambo Jesu muzindi walikuswanana mpawo abasikwiya bakwe.
Mponya Judasi, kendelezya imbungano lya basilumamba abamwi mapulisa kuzwa kubamapaizi bapati amafalisi, bakainka kuya a tumpalamba, minze nge, ezilwanyo.
Monya Jesu,wakazi zyonse zintu zyakali kucitika kulinguwe, wakainka kunembo okubabuzya, nguni ngumuyanda.
Bakamutaba, Jesu woko Nazaleta , Jesu wakamba kuli mbabo, ndime Judasi wakamwaba, walinvwi abasilumamba.
Nakamba kulimbabo, ndime bakapiluka musule okuwa
Mponya ape wakababuzya, nguni ngumuyanda , ape bakamba, Jesu woku Nazelata .
Jesu wakataba, ndamyambila kuti ndime. Kokuti muyanda mebo, aba bazwe.
Eci calimumulawo kuzuzikizya majwi ngakamba. Kuliabo mbumwandipa, takwe ngundakaswekelwa.
Mponya Sayimoni ppetulo, wakajesi sabule wakaiswenzya okutimbula twi lyo mubelesi womupaizi mupati kulilyo lwaakwe. Ino ninzi lyoyu mubelesi lyakali maicus.
Jesu wakamba kuli petuli, pilusya sabule mukati mucibikilo calyo. Kokuti nditanwi mucinywidapa batata.
E mbunga wabasilumamba aba endelezi, abapulisa ba juda, bakamujata Jesu okumwanga.
Bakamutola kusanguna kuli Ananiyasi, kambo walimukwe wa Caiaphas, wakali mupaizi mupati mwaka ulya.
Ino Caiaphas nguwakapede kuyacula kumajuda kuti kulakozika kubota kuti muntu omwi wafwida bantu.
Simoni petulo wakamucilila Jesu , osikwiya omwi. Ino ulya sikwiya walizibinkene kumupaizi mupati, ino nakanjila Jesu munyanda yomupaizi mupati.
Ino petulo wakalinvwi amulyango anze. Umwi sikwiya wa Jesu, wakazibinkene kumupaizi mupati, wakainka anze okwamba kuli sikugadela mulyango, okumunjzya petulo mukati.
Monya mwanakazi mubelesi, sikugadela muyango,bakamba kuli petulo ,ino toinsi umwi wabasikwiya boyo mwalimi wakataba kuti, tainsi mebo.
Ino babelesi abapulisa balinvwi alya, babbikide mulilo, kambo kwali kutontola, bali kasazya. Petulo wali ambabo , kainka alya kalisazya.
Mupaizi mupati mponya wakabuzya Jesu kujatilizya basikwiya bakwe okukwisya kwakwe.
Jesu wakamutaba, ndakambola cantangalala kunyindali kwisya cindi conse muzikombelo oko kubaswanganina majuda bonse. Takwe cindakamba kumbali.
Cinnzi ciwandizizya buzya abo bakandin vwa cindi kambo . Langa bantu balizi cinda kamba.
Nakambanamu Jesu, umwi wabapulisa wainvwi awo wakamu kamba Jesu okuti, ino mbota mupaizi mupati namu.
Jesu wakamutaba, na ndamba obi, pa bukamboni kuzibi, na ino unumina nzi.
Mponya Ananiyasi wakamutuma kangidwe kuli Caiaphas mupaizi mupati.
Ino Simoni petulo kainvwi kalikasaizya . Bantu mponya bakati kulinguwe, sena toinsi umwi waba Juda bakwe , wakaka okuti , tainsi.
Umwi wababelesi bo mupaizi , wecibbululu womwalumi petulo ngwakatimbwide twi, wakati, takwe nindaka kubona anguwe mumunda na.
Mponya petulo wakakaka ape, mponyina awo muzingili wakalila
Mponya bakamutola Jesu kuzwa kuli Kefasi kuya kucizekelo cipati. Kwali kuseni seni , mponyina takwe nibakanjila mucizekelo kuti batalisofwazi, pele bakonze kulya kabotu pasika.
Mponya pilato wakainka anze kuli mbabo okwamba kuti, kubejekezya nzi kumweta kujatikizya oyu muntu.
Bakataba okwamba kuti kulinguwe, na oyu muntu tainsi simuzicita zibi nitwata mupa kuli yebo.
Kakako aka Pilato wakati kulimbabo, mumutole nwebo nobeni mukamuzekisye kwendelanya omulawo ywenu, ma Juda bakamba kulinguwe, taciyinsi mumulawo kuliswe kujaya muntu uliwonse.
Bakamba namu kuteti ikwi lya Jesu lizulile ndyamba kutondezya lufu dwatakafwe.
Mponya Pilato wakanjila ape mucizekelo cipati okwita Jesu okwamba kulinguwe kuti ndiwe mwami wama Juda.
Jesu wakataba ino wambola kuzwa mutati kako na kulibakwambila kujatikizya zyangu.
pilato wakataba tandinsi Juda , ndime na. Mukowa wako abapaizi bapati bakupa kuli me. Ino wacita nzi.
Jesu wakataba, bulelo bwangu tabwinsi bwenyika kambe bulelo bwangu bwa ansi ano, babelesi bangu nibandilwanina kuti nditapegwi kuba Juda. Pele bulelelo bwangu tabwizwi kuno.

mponya Pilato wakati kulinguwe, ili mwami na, Jesu wakataba ,wamba kuti ndili mwami. Kambo kako cindakazyalwa, akambo kako ndasik nyika, kuti ndipe bukamboni bwamasimpe. Bonse bazulilwa kukasimpe balavwa jwi lwangu.
Pilato wakamba kulinguwe, masimpe ninzi, mponya nakamba ezi , wakainka kuma Juda sijene kambo mumuntu oyu.
pele mulijesi ciyanza cokuti ndigwisye umwi muntu kulinwebo cindi cepasika . Ino muyanda kuti ndimugwisizye mwami wama Juda.
Mponya bakalila cokongolola ukwamba kuti tutabi oyo mwalumi, kono Bbanabbasi. Ino Bbanabbasi wali nguwali sikulwanisya.
Ino Pilato wakabweza Jesu okumuuma.
Basilumamba bakasuma mushini wobumvwa. Pawo baka ubika kumutwe wa Jesu okumu zwatika cibiya cha pepo.
Bakaza kuli nguwe okwamba kuti, ''Wongola, Mwami wama Juda!'' ponya baka muuma.
Ino Pilato wakainka anze ape okubambila ati, ''Amubone, ndiyobumweta anze kuli nywebo kutegwa muzibe kuti takwe mulandu ngunda jana muli nguwe.''
Pawo Jesu wakazwida anze, kazwete mushini wobumvwa E chibiya cha pepo. Pilato wakateti kuli mbabo, ''Amulange, ngoyu mwalumi!''

Bapaizi bapati aba sikalumamba nibaka mubona buyo Jesu, bakongolola okuteti, ''Amumu kankamine, amumu kankamine!'' Pilato wakati kuli mbabo, ''Amumubweze nywebo mukamu kankamine, kambo takwe mulandu ngunda jana muli nguwe.''
Ma Juda bakamutaba, ''Tuli jesi mulawo, ponya kwendelanya o mulawo oyo welede kufwa kambo ulyamba kuti Mwana a Leza.''
Ino Pilato nakamvwa kambo aka wakaindilila kuyowa,
wakanjila mung'anda mpati ye mfulumende ape okwambila Jesu kuti, ''Uzwida kuli?'' Pele Jesu takwe nakamutaba.
Pawo Pilato wakateti kuli nguwe, ''Ninzi toli kundambozyi? Tozi kuti ndile-nguzu zyoku kuleka, ape enguzu zyoku kukankamina?''
Jesu wakamutaba, ''Takwe nguzu zyojesi ali mebo ati buyo ezyo zyaka pegwa kuli yebo kuzwa ku julu. Pele, oyo wakandaaba kuli yebo ngule cibi chipati.''

Kukutaba oku, Pilato wakasoleka kumwangununa, kono ma Juda bakongolola, okuti, ''Wamuleka buyo oyu mwalumi, kokuti anu toinsi mwenzinyina wa Siezar. Woonse muntu uli panga mwami wambola kukazya Siezar.''
Ino Pilato nakamvwa majwi aya, wakatola Jesu anze oku kala muchibbula che nkuta mu busena bwitwa kuti ''Nkanzo ya mabwe,'' kono mumushobo wechi Aramaiki, ngu ''Gabbatha.''
Ino bwali buzuba bokulibambila Paseka, ku ciindi che woola lyasanu akomwi. Pilato wakateti kuma Juda, ''Amubone ngoyu mwami wenu!''
Bakongolola, ''Azwe, azwe; amumu kankamine!'' Pilato wakati kuli mbabo, ''Ndimu kankamine mwami wenu?'' Bapaizi bapati bakataba, ''Tatukwe umbi mwami pele Siezar.''
Poonya Pilato wakamwaba Jesu kuli mbabo kuti aka kankaminwe.
Pawo bakamutola Jesu, wakazwida anze, kali nyamunide mpanda, kwinka ku busena bwitwa kuti ''Busena bo tupepe tobongo,'' echo citwa kuti mumushobo we chi Aramaiki ''Gologotha.''
Baka mukankamina Jesu konya kuya, kumbali lyakwe kwali balumi bambi bobile, umwi ku lubazu lumbi Jesu kali akati.
Pilato ape wakalemba bulembo okububika ampanda. Awo bwali lembidwe: JESU OKU NAZARETA, MWAMI WA MA JUDA.
Ma Juda banji baka bu- bala bulembo obu akambo kokuti busena kwa kankaminwa Jesu bwali afwifwi o munzi. Bulembo bwali lembidwe mu chi Aramaiki, chi Latini O mu chi Giriki.
Ponya bapaizi bapati bama Juda bakateti kuli Pilato, ''Utalembi kuti, 'Mwami wa ma Juda,' kono, 'Oyu wakamba ati, ''Ndili Mwami wa ma Juda.''''
Pilato wakataba, ''Echo chindalemba chindalemba.''
Basilumamba nibaka mukankamina Jesu, baka bweza zibiya zyakwe, oku zyabanya muzi panzi zyone, chomwi-comwi ngwaya; E chibaki chakwe ape. Ino chibaki takwe nicha sumidwe, chali vwangene buyo comwi.

Pawo bakambozyanya, ''Atatu chiyauli, kono atusowele nsolo tubone na cilaba cani.'' Echi chakacitika kuti mangwalo azulile alikuti, ''Baka lyabanya zibiya zyangu akati kabo oku sowela nsolo azizwato zyangu.'' Ezi zibakacita basilumamba.
Ino baimvwi afwifwi E mpanda ya Jesu bali banyina, bazyalwa- nyina ba banyina, Maria muka Klopas, O Maria Magadelana.
Pawo Jesu nakabona banyina osikwiya ngwali kuyandisya kabaimvwi afwifwi, wakateti kuli banyina, ''Mwanakazi, bona, mwanako mushimani!''
Mponya wakati kuli sikwiya, ''Bona, mbaba banyoko!'' Kuzwa ku woola liya sikwiya wakamutola ku nga'nda yakwe.
Nichakainda ciindi, kazi kuti zyoonse zintu zyacitwa amangwalo kuti azulile, Jesu wakati, ''Ndafwa nyota.''
Chibikilo cazwide waini upapa chalibikidwe alya, ino bakanika ciponshi kacizwide waini upapa kucishomeka ku sumo okwitola ku mulomo wakwe.
Jesu nakanywa waini upapa, wakati, ''Kwamaninina.'' Waka kotamika mutwe wakwe oku gwisya muuya wakwe.

Poonya ma Juda, kambo kokuti bwali buzuba bokulibambila, okuti mibili itasyali ampanda ciindi che Nsabata (Kambo buzuba bwe Nsabata bwali kuyandisigwa), baka kumbila Pilato kuti maulu abo atyololwe oku bagwisya.
Pawo basilumamba bakaza okutyola maulu omwalumi okusanguna ape awoyo wabili wakankaminidwe O Jesu.
Nibakaza kuli Jesu, bakabona kuti wali fwide kale, ponya takwe nibaka mu tyolela maulu akwe.
Nokuba namuya, umwi waba silumamba waka muyasa kubbazu E sumo, ponya buyo alya malowa amanzi akazwa.
Oyo wakacibona echi wakapa bumboni ape bumboni bwakwe mbwa masimpe. Ulizi kuti chakaamba ca masimpe kutegwa anywibo mukashome.
Ezi zintu zyaka citika muku zuzikizya mangwalo, ''Kutakwe olo lyomwi fuwa lyakwe liyo -tyolwa.''
Ape, mangwalo amba kuti, ''Bayomulanga oyo nguba kayasa.''

Nizyakainda buyo ezi zintu, Josefa oku Arimateya, akambo kokuti wali sikwiya wa Jesu (kono yokusisikizya akambo kobuyofu bwa ma Juda), waka kumbila Pilato kuti na ninga wakubweza mutunta wa Jesu. Pilato waka muzumizya. Ino Josefa wakaza okuutola mutunta wakwe.
Nikodemasi awe wakaza, oyo ku kusanguna wakainka kuli Jesu masiku. Waketa tununkilizyo tuvwenene O murrih o alo, mweelwe wemwaanda yama litiras.
Pawo bakatola mutunta wa Jesu oku vungaila muzisila zituba antomwi emisamu inunkilila, mbuli muchali cilengwa cha ma Juda moku zika mitunta.
Ino mubusena mwaka kankaminwa mwali muunda; poonya mu muunda mwali bbita lipya omo mwatalina kuzikilwa muntu naba omwi.
Akambo kokuti bwali buzuba bo kulibambila bwa ma Juda baka muzika Jesu muli ngayo kambo maumbwe alafwifwi
Ino kuseni mazuba bokusangula bwesunda Maliya Mangandelena wakasika kumbita oku bona bwe kalinkunkulisindwe kuzwa ambita.
Mponya wazuza wakainka kuli Saimoni Petulo okuli basikwiya bakwe abo jesu mbali kuyanda, mponya wakati, "Bamutola mwami kuzwa mubita ape. Tatuzi kuba kumulazika."
Mponyina Petulo obamwi basikwiya bakainka ku bita'
Bakazuza bonse bobile, pele oyo sikwaya umwi wakamusiya Petulo wasanguna kusika kubita.
Nakainma wakasondela wakabona zizwato zituba pele takwe nakanjila mukati.
Simoni Petulo anguwe wasika uyo bumuchilila wajila mubita wabona zibya zituba mukati mpozili.
Anchicho chibya chazinguluside kumutwe techali insi azyenyina, pele chalivungidwe achilike.
Mponyina umwi sikwiya, oyo wakasanguna ku bita wakanjila anguwe, wabona oku syoma.
Kuzwa chiya chidi tibainoziba, kuti ulelede kubuka kubafu.
Mponyinyina basikwiya bakabweda kuli bo.
Kono Maliya walinvwi ebita kalila.
Wakamba bangelo bobile muzituba kabakede, umwi kumutwe, umwi kumaulu ako mubili wa Jesu nkuwalazikidwe.
Bakati kuli nguwe, "Mwanakazi, ulilanzi?" Wakabambila kuti "kambo bamutola Mwami, mponyina tandizi kubakumu tula."
Nakamba namu waka chebuka kusule wabona Jesu ulimvwi, Kono takwe naka muziba kuti ngu Jesu.
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, mwanakazi, ninzi cholila? Ngwani ngoyandola? We wakayeya kuti mulimi, mponyina wakati kuli nguwe, "Mwami, namwamutola amundambile oko nkomwa musisa."
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, "Maliya." Waka chebuka okwamba kulinguwe muchi Alamiki, "Laboni" ("Mwiyi.")
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, "Utandijati kambo tadinoinka kuli tata, kono winke kubazyalwama okuyo amba kuli mbabo, kuti ndiyoinka kuli tata, ape bauso, kuli Leza wangu o Leza wenu.
Maliya Magadalena wakaza okuzo ambila basikwiya, ndamubona mwami,"Okwamba zintu ombwakamwambila makani aya kuli nguwe.

Kujolezya lyo buya buzuba buzuba bokusanguna, zitendele zyali jalidwe oko basikwiya kobabede, kambo koku tija basikwiya, Jesu wakaza okwima akati kabo okwamba kuti kulimbabo, Lumuno alube akati kabo ."
Naka mana kwamba namu, waka batondezya manza akwe abazu lyakwe. Ba sikwiya bakabotelwa nebaka bona Mwami.
Jesu mponya wakati kulimbabo, Lumuno lube anywib. Mbuli bwakandituma tata, amibo ndamutuma.
Nakamba namu. Jesu wakabafulidila munya okwamba kuti kulimbabo, "Amutambule muya usalala
Kufumbwa muntu ngumulekelela milandu yalekelwa, kufumbwa wabisiya ulekelelwa ulalekela."
Tomasi, umwi wabali kumi ababili walikutegwa ngwa mambile talinsi ambabo awo Jesu nakasika.
bamwi basikwiya bakati kulinguwe, "twamubona mwami."
Nekwakainda mazuba alimusanu atatu basichiya balimukati ape, o Tomasi waliwo. Jesu wakaza kono zitendele zyali jalidwe, okwima akati kabo okwamba kuti lumuno lube anyibo.
Mponyina wakati kuli Tomasi, "Inzya munwe okubona manza angu. Inzya awa manza ako okunzya milimebo. Utabi sikuzumbozya kono syoma."
Tomasi wakataba wati, "O Mwami wangu, o Leza wangu."
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, kambo wandibona wasyoma. Balilelekidwe abo batakabona pele bala syoma.
Ino Jesu wakachita zitondezyo zinji kubusya bwabasikwiya, zitondezyo zyatakalembwa muli Eli buku.
Pele ezi zyaka lembwa kuti musyome kuti Jesu ngu Kilistu mwana Leza, okuti kusyoma mube obumi muzina lyakwe.
Nikwainda ezi zintu Jesu wakaliyubununa kuli basikwiya bakwe ku lwizi lwa Tibeliyasi. Namuya mbwakaliyubulula.
Simoni Pita wali antomwi o Timasi wirwa kuti Disimasi, Nataliyeli uzwa ku kana mu Galilaya, bana ba Zebedi, ape abamwi basikwiya bobile ba Jesu.
Saimoni Pita wakati kuli mbabo,"mdiyobuya kuyozela nswi."Bakati kulinguwe,Äswibo tulaza ayibo."Bakainka bakujila mubwato, pele takwe ncibakajata masiku ense.
Ino kakuli bwaca kale kuseni seni, Jesu wakaima ankomwe, pele basikwiya takwe nibakaziba kuti ngu
Jesu.Mponya Jesu wakati kuli mbabo,"Nomijaha, mulijesi cokulya na?"Bakamutaba, "ne"
Wakati kulimbabo, amufuse kandikenu kubbazu lye cilisya co bwato ape mulajana zimwi, mponya bakasowa kandi kabe pele takwe nibakakonzya kukakwela nkambo kwali nswi mpati zinji.
Mponya sikwiya ngwalikuyandisisya Jesu wakati kuli Pita,"mwami."wakazwa zizwato zyakwe(nkambo walizunwida), mponya wakalifusa mulwizi.
Umwi wabasikwiya wakaza kubwato(nkambo tibalinsi kule enkomwe, nkumbo twali buyo tukokola mwanda omwi) ape balikukwela kaindi kazwide nswi.
Mponya nibakasika kunkomwe, bakabona mulilo wa malasha awo ape enswi ziyokwa alinguwo, antomwi ecinkwa.
Jesu wakati kulimbabo,"Amwete zimwi nswi zimwazwa akujata
,"Saimoni Pita mponya wakainka wakweta kaindi kunkomwi kazwide nswi mpati, zili mwanda amakumi asanwe ezitatu, pele nikuba kuti zyali zinji kaindi takwe nikakayauka.
Jesu wakati kulimbabo,"kamuza mususule pele takwe naba sikwiya wakayeya kumubuzya kuti,"ndiwe ni? Balizi kuti ngnguwe mwami.
Jesu wakaza, wabweza cinkwa, ape wacipa kuli mbabo, ape anzizyo nswi.
Eci cali cindi catatu eco Jesu ncakaliyubununa kuli basikwiya kuzwa nakabuka kubafu.

Nibakamana kususula, Jesu wakati kuli Saimoni Pita,"Saimoni mwana Joni, ulandiyanda kwinda aba?"Pita wakati kuli nguwe, iyi mwami, ulizi kuti ndilakuyanda."Jesu wakati kuli nguwe, "Lisya mbelele zyangu."
Wakati kulinguwe ape lwabili,"Saimoni mwana Joni, ulayanda?"Pita wakati kuli nguwe, Ïyi mwami, ulizi kuti ndilakuyanda."Jesu wakati kulinguwe, embela mbelel zyangu.

Wakati kulinguwe lwatatuSimoni mwana Joni, ulamdiyanda?"Pita wakabijilwa nkambo Jesu wakamubuzya zindi zyotatwe, Ïno ulandiyanda?"wakati kulinguwe, mwami uizi zintu zyeense ulizi kuti ndilakuyanda."Jesu wakati kulinguwe,"lisya mbelele zyangu.

Nconzyo nconyo, ndakakwambila kuti niwacili munini wali kulyanga omwini okwenda kufumbwa nkuwalikuyanda, pele wakuba mudala uyotambika manza ako, mponya umwi buyo uyokwanga okukutola nkoyayandi kwinka,
Ïno Jesu wakamba eci mukuti atondezye mbuli bube bolufu Pita mbwalelede kulemenezya leza. Nakamana kwamba eci wakati kuli Pita,"ndicilila.
Pita wakacebuka ape wakabona sikwiya oyu Jesu ngwalikuyandisisya kayobubacilila, oyo ape wasegede kuli Jesu acilawo ape, wakati,"mwami ngwani oyo uyokwaba?"
Pita wakamubona mponya wakati kuli Jesu,"mwami, ino oyo muntu uyocita nzi?
Jesu wakati kulinguwe,"kuti nkeyanda kuti akale mane ndisike, ninzi eco kuliyebo? ndicilile."
Mponya kwamba oku kwakaduma akati kabazyalwanyina, kuli sikwiya oyo talelede kufwa, pele Jesu takwe nakamba kuli Pita umwi takofwa pele kuti tayanda kuti akale, ninzi eco kuliyebo.
Oyo ngo sikwiya upa bumboni bwe zintu ezi, ape nduwakalemba zintu ezi ape tulizi kuti bumboni bwakwe mbwe nconzyo.

Nkuzili ape zimwi zintu ezyo Jesu nconzyo zyakacita. Kuti cimwi ecimwi cicakalembwa, ndiyeya kuti cimwi nyika lwayo niyatakakonzya kuti nanga nyika lwayo niyatakakonzya kubamba mabbuku akayelede kulembwa.
Buku lye chindi ndi nda kalemba, Theophelasi, wakamba zyonse Jeso nzya kaisya,
kusikila buzuba mbwaka tolwa mu julu,na kamana kupa malailile kwindila mu muya usalala ku ma Apostola mbaka sala.
Ni kwakamana kupenga kwakwe,wa kalitondezya kuti ucipona azitondezyo zyakuti ba zuliwe, mumazuba ama kumi one wakalitondezya kuli mbabo, mponya okubambila abwami bwa kujulu.
Ino nalikuswanana ambabo , wakabalailela okwamba kuti batazwi mu Jelusalema , pele kuti balindile cisyomezyo ca tata, eco cakamba kuti, wakamvwa kuli mebo.
Kuti Joni kasimpe waliku bbizya mumanzi , pele muyobbizigwa mumuya uaslala mazuba mace.
Nibakabungana antomwe bakamubuzya, mwami eci ncecico cindi coyobozya bwami bwaka bwaku Izilayili,
wakamba kulimbabo, tacinsi kuli nwebo kuziba zindi ezyo tata zyakabika munguzu zyakwe.
Pele muyotambula nguzu muya usalala wayoseluka alinwebo, mponya muyoba bakamboni bangu mu Jelusalema amonse mu Judiya omu Somaliya, ape okumamanino enyika.
Mwami Jesu nakamana kwamba ezyi zintu, nibaliku langa kujulu, wakazo nyumunwa, mponya kumbi yakazomusisa kumenso abo.
Nibaliku langisisya kujulu kabwinka, mponya balumi bobile bakaima ezi zwato zituba.
Bakamba , nobalumi boku Galili, ninzi nomwimvwi awo akamulanga kujulu, oyu Jesu wakatolwa kuzwa kuli nwebo kuinka kujulu, oyupiluka monya mucimo mumwakamu bona kainka kujulu.
Mponya bakapiluka mu Jelusalema kuzwa kumulundu witwa oliveti oyu ulatwi o Jelusalema, bwende butola mazuba e nsabata.

Nibakasika, bakainka kutanta munyanda ,ilatala, oko kubalikukala. Balibene Petulo, Joni, Jemusi, Andulu, Filipo, Tomasi, Bbatolome Mateyo, Jemusi mwana wa Apeyasi , Sayimoni muna ziloti, o Juda mwana wa Jemusi.
Bonse balilipede kumakanze omwe aswana mumpailo, atomwi abanakazi, o Maliya banyina ba Jesu, mponya abazyalwanyina.
Muli awo mazuba Petulo wakaima akati kabazyalwanyina, abantu bali mwanda omwi amakumi obile, mponya okwamba,
Nobakwesu, cila yandikana kuti mangwalo nzulilwe, ayo muya usalala ngwaka twambila kwindila akanya k Davida kungama Judasi , oyo wakandilezya basiku jata Jesu.
Pele wali wakati kesu amana wakatambula lubazu bwe mulimo.
Ino oyu mwalumi waula munda kwindila mali nyaka yambula mumicito yakwe abi, Ape wakawisya mutwe cakusanguna, mponya mubili kwandika cokujula, mponya zyonse zyomukati zyaka tika anze.
Bonse bakali mu Jelusalema bakacimvwa eci , mponya bakaita ulya munda mumusyobo wabo kuti Akeledema, nkokuti munda wobulowa.
Mbuli mbocilembedwe mubbuku lyentembauzyo, amuleke munda wakwe wanzanwe, ape mutaleki na muntu omwi akale kuya amuleke umbi abweze busena bobwendelezi.
Ninga cakonzeka, kuti omwi wabalumi wali aswibo cindi conse Jesu nakanjila okuzwa aliswebo.
Katalikila kulubizya lwa Joni kubuzuba mbwakazo bwezegwa kuzwa kuli swebo, abe mumboni aswibo wokubuka kwakwe.
Bakabika kunembo balumi bolile, Josefa witwa Bbanabbasi, oyo walizoitidwe Jusitasi o Matiyasi o Matiyasi.
Bakakomba okwamba, yebo, mwami , ulizi myoyo yabantu , ino liyobunune kuti ino nguni ali aba balumi bobile nguwasala.
Kutola mulimo kumasena abu apositola obu Juda mbwaketa ansi kuti ainke kubusena bwakwe.
Ino bakatalika kulisalila mponya banji bakaza kuli Matiyasi ,ape wakazo bikwa abo bali kumi akomwi.
Nibwakasika buzuba bwa pentecosita, baliswangene antomwi acibaka comwi.
Mpawo kwakasika muzumo kuzwa kujulu mbuli guwo lyunga, lya kazuzya nganda yonse mubali kede.
Kwa kabasikila malimi kulimbabo mbuli mulilo waka etwa, wakabakala amitwe yabo nguwaya.
Boonse bakazuzigwa o muya usalala oku talika mwambo mu malimi manji, mbonya mbu wakabotondezya muya.
Mponya kwali ma Juda bali kukala mu Jelusalemu, baalumi bashomi, kuzwa ku masi ali munsi e julu.
Ino muzuzumo oyu niwakamvwika, makamu abantu akaza okukomokwa kambo muntu o muntu wakabanvwa kaba ambola mu mushobo wakwe.
Baka komokwa bakti masimpe, tabali bonse bambola ci Galileya?
Ino nkambo nzi kuti mane tulikubanvwa, nguwaya wakwe mu wa kazyalilwa?
Patians o Medes o Elamites, abo bali kukala mu Mesopotamia, mu Judiya omu Kapadosia, mu Pontus omu Asia,
Pragia o Patiyasi, zyoku Egepita zibaka zimwi zyoku libiya kuswena ku Cilene, abenzu bazwa ku Roma,
Ma Juda aba Proselite, ba Cretani aba Arabia, tulabanvwa kabamba mu mishobo yesu mu mi sebezi mipati ya leza.'
Bonse bakakomokwa oku ziyelwa; bakambola kuli umwi o umwi, camba nzi eci?
Kono bamwi bakafubazika okwamba, bakolwa waini mupya.'
Kono Pita wakaima abamwi bali kumi aumwi, wa kongolola ejwi lyakwe, okwamba kuli mbabo, mobalumi baku Judeya anywibo bakala mu Jelusalemu, acizibwe eci kuli nguwe, amuswililezye majwi angu.
Aba bantu taba kaidwe, mbuli mbubamuyeya, nkambo cipanzi catatu ca hola co buzuba.
Kono eci cakambwa mukwindila mu mumusinsimi Joilo.
Cindi camamanino, leza mbwamba, ndiyo tila muya wangu mu mibili, bana benu ba shimani aba simbi bayo sinsima, bana benu banini balombe ba yo bona zilengano, ama daala benu bayo lota
Masimpe mu bazike bangu bazike bangu be canakazi muli ayo mazuba ndiyo tila muya wangu, ape bayo sinsima.
Ndiyo tondezya zigambya mujulu e zitondezyo mu nyika ansi, bulowa, mulilo o sikunkwe wo busi.
Izuba liyosandulwa ku kusiya o mwezi ku bulowa kabutana kusika buzuba bupati lilembedwe lyo mwami lyasika.
Ciyoba kuti kufumbwa wita muzina lyo mwami uyo futulwa!
Nobalumi ba Izilaeli, amwanvwe majwi aya. Jesu wa Nazaleta wali mwalumi wapedwe kulinywe o leza a malele azicito e zigambya e zitondezyo leza nzyakacita kwinda mulinguwe mukuti kene mbuli mbomuzi.
Oyu mwalumi wakapegwa o mwami mumakanze o busongo, a nywibo, mumanza a balumi batakwe mano, ku mubika kulufu muku mukankamina a cipingano.
Kono leza wakamubusya, kumugwisya mukucisa ko lufu, nkambo ticali elede nguwe kujeswi eco.
Akambo Davida wakamba zyakwe, ndamubona mwami cindi cinse kaitana nkumo yangu, akambi we uli kumbali ejanza lyangu lyo lulyo kategwa ata swenzuki
Mpawo moyo wangu wali nonenidwe o lulimi lwangu lwakabotelwa. O mubili wangu uyopona mukushoma.
Akambo tokoyosiya muya wangu ku babi na uyo zumizya oyo usalala kubona kubola. Wakazibwa kuli mebo inzila zyo bumi, uyo zumizya oyo usalala kubona kubola.
Wakazibwa kuli mebo inzila zyo bumi, uyondipanga kubotelwa kuzwide o busyu bwako.
Nobazyalwama, cilelede kuli mebo kwambola kuli nywe zya Davida, kuti wakafwa ape wakazikwa e bita lyakwe mpalicili esunu.
Mponya, wali musinsimi okuziba kuti leza waka konka e ckonke kulinguwe kutegwa uyobika umwi walunyungu lwakwe acuno.
Wakabona cali kuyocitika kunembo ukuyo amba zyo bubuke bwa kilisito.
Oyu Jesu leza wakamubusya, mponya swebo tubakamboni.
Mpawo, mbwasumpwidwe kujana lyalulyo lya leza okutambula cishomezyo co muya usalala kuzwa kuli baisi, wakatila eco ncimubona akunvwa.
Akaambo Davida takwe nakainka kujulu, kono wakati, leza wangu wamba kuli leza wangu, kala a janza lyangu lyolulyo.
Ati ndicite basinkondonyoko citandabalilo ca maulu ako.
Mpawo, amuleke nganda ya Izilayeli kuti izibe kuti leza a wamupanga mububili leza o kilisito, oyu Jesu ngumwa kajaya.
Ino nibakanvwa eci, bakayaswa mumyoyo, okwamba kuli Pita aba Apositolo bonse,' nobazyalwama, tulacita buti?
Mponya Pita wakati kuli mbabo, amwempwe oku babatizigwa, muzina lya Jesu kilisito mukujatilwa kwe zibi zyenu, ape muyo tambula cipego co muya usalala.
Nkambo cishomezyo eci ncicenu abana benu okuli abo bali kule mbuli bantu mbali mwami o leza uyo ita.
Oku majwi wakapa buboni oku bakombelezya, kwamba, amufutulwe kubantu babi becino cindi.
Mpona nibakatambula eli jwi baka babapilusigwa, ape baka yugizigwa muli obo buzuba bali zyuulu zyotatwe bakabatizigwa.
Bakacili kunjisyo zyabapositola mukuswngana a amuya amu kukomona cinkwa amukukomba.
Kuyowa kwakaza ku myuya, zigambya zintu ezitondezyo zyakacitwa mu ba Apositolo.
Bonse bakashoma bali antomwi bavwania zyoonse zibajesi mubumwi.
Mponya bakauzya zintu zyabo babana bonse, kwendelana mbuli muntu omuntu mbwajesi.
Ino buzuba obuzuba bali kuswangana antomwi mucindi comwi mu tempele. Bakakomona cinkwa mu manda, bali kwanana cilyo antomwi mukubotelwa e myoyo ituba.
Kulumba leza okuba luyando ku bantu bonse, ape buzuba o buzuba mwami wakayungizya ku mpalo yabo baka futulwa.
Ino Pita o Joni bakainka ku tempele a ciindi cokukomba, cali cindi cacikasalizi.
Mponya mwalumi umwi wakali lembde kuzwa mwida lyabanyina walikutolwa kumulyango we tempele utegwa mubotu. Balikumbila kugwasya kuli abo balikunjila mu tempele.
Ino nakabona Pita o Joni kabanjilamu tempele, wakabakumbila lugwasya.
Pita, wakamulangisisya, anguwe Joni, wakati, "tulanze."
Mwalumi ulemede wakabalanga, kayeya kuti kutambula cimwi cintu kuli mbabo.
Pele Pita wakateli,"nsijisi nsiliva na ngolide, pele ncejesi ndilakupa, muzina lya Jesu kilisito woku Nazareta,enda."
akamujata ejanza lyecilisya, Pita wakamwimika, mponyanina maulu o muntu engongozi zyakwe zyakajana nguzu.
Wakasotoka, mwakumi mulema wakaima okutalika kwenda, mponya wakanjila mu tempele aba Pita o Joni, kayenda, kasotoka, okulumbaizya leza.
Bantu beense bakamubona uleenda okulumbaizya leza.
Bakamuziba kuti ngonguwe muntu wali kukumbila kugwisisgwa mulyango mubotu we tempele: mponya bakaziyelwa okukomokwa kuli eezyo zyakamucitikila.
Ino nakacili kujatilila Pita o Joni, bantu beense bakazuzanina kuli mbabo mukota litegwa lya solomoni, bakankamuka loko.
Ino Pita nakabona eci, wakabataba bantu,"nobalumi ba Isilayeli, ino mukankakanzi? twakamwenzya muntu oyu munguzu zyesu na bululami?
Leza wa Abulahamu, owa Isaka, owa Jakobo, leza wamatata, nguwa kamulemenezya mubelesi wakwe Jesu ngumwakaba okumukaka kumeso a Pilato, nikuba kuti we walikuyanda kuti amwangunune.
Nywebo mwakamukak usalala ululeme, mponya mwakakumbila mujayi kuti bamwangude nguwe.
Mwkajaya matalikilo obuumi, oyo ngwakabusya leza kuzwa kubafu_ino swebo tulibakamboni beci.
Ino kambo kakusyoma izina lyakwe, oyo ngumubona ngumuzi ngumobona enguzu. Lusyomo kwindila muli Jesu lyamupa kuona kabotu kunembo lyenu nywense.
Ino nobazyalwama, ndilizi kuti mwakazicita ezi kwinda mukutaziba mbubonya mbobakacita bendelezi benu.
Pele izi zinti leza wakazulizya oko nkwambide amilomo yabasinsimi bense, kuti kilisito lwakwe ulelede kupenga, ino wakacizuzikizya.
Amweempwe, mponya, musanduke, kutegwa izibi zyenu zigwisigwe,
Kuti cisike cindi cokwambilizigwa kuzwa kubusyu bwa leza"ape kuti akatume kilisito ngwakasala kambo kenu, Jesu.
We leede kukala kujulu mane kusikila cikasike cindi cokubambulula zintu zyeense, ezyi leza zyakambilizya ciindi kwinda mimilawo zyakambilizya cindi kwinda mumilomo yabasinsimi bakwe bsalala.
Moses conzyo wakati,"mwami, lezauyomubusizya musinsimi mbuli ndime kuzwa akati kabananyoko.
Muyoswilizya kuzintu zyeense zyataka mwambile. Kuyoba kuti muntu wense utayoswilili musinsimi oyo uyonyonyonwa cokumanina akati kabantu.
Ii, ape bense basinsimi kuzwa kuli Samiyele ape abo bakaza musule lyakwe, abo bakamba mazuba aya.
Nywebo muli bana ba basinsimi ape aba cizuminano ca leza ncakapa kuli basikale benu, nakati kuli Ablahamukwindila'munyungu yako ndiyoileleka mukwasyi yeense yamunyika.
Nikwakamana leza wakabusya mubelesi wakwe, wakamutuma kusanguna kuti ndinywe, kuti amulekeke okusandula umwi oumwi womulindinwe kuzwa munzila zi.
Awo Petro O Joni nibali kwambola kubantu, bapaizi mwendelezi we tempele ama Sadduki bakasika ali mbabo.
Baka pengana loko kambo Petro O Joni bali kwisya bantu okwamba kubuka kwa Jesu kuli bafwide.
Baka bajata oku babika muntolongo kusikila mafumina aka chilila, mukubona kuti kwali ku jolezya.
Kono bantu banji bakamvwa mulumbe bakashoma; omweelwe wabalumi bakashoma wali kusika ku myanda yosanwe.
Chakacitika mubuzuba bwaka chilila kuti baleli babo, amalu, abalembi bakabungana antomwi mu Jerusalemu.
Annasi mupaizi mupati waliwo, Kaifasi, O Joni, Alexanda, abo boonse bali bomukowa omupaizi mupati.
Nibaka babika Petro O Joni akati kabo, baka babuzya, ''Kwindila munguzu nzi na zina nzi, mumwacita ezi?''
Pawo Petro, kazwide muuya usalala, wakati kuli mbabo, ''Nywebo nobaleli babantu, amalu,
kuti tuli muku zekisigwa sunu akambo komulimo mubotu wacitwa ku mwalumi mulwazi, enzila njaponisigwa,

akuzibwe kulinywe noonse oku bantu boonse ba Isilayeli kuti oyu muntu waima kunembo lyenu kali aseba zibotu muzina lya Jesu Kristu oku Nazareta, oyo ngumwaka bambula, pele we Leza ngwakabusya kuzwa kubafu.
Jesu Kristu ndibbwe elyo nywebo nobayaki ndimwaka sampaula kono ino lyaba ndyebbwe liyandikana.
Takwe lufutuko muli umbi muntu, kambo takwe zina limbi kunsi E julu lipedwe akati kabantu mbutwelede kufutulwa.''
Pawo nibakabona chamba ca Petro O Joni okwibaluka kuti bali bantu buyo, balumi batayide, bakakomokwa, nibakaziba kuti Petro O Joni bali O Jesu.
Kambo bakabona mwalumi wakaponisigwa kaimvwi ambabo, ponya baka bula chokwamba.
Ino nibakalailila bapostola kuti bazwe mumuswangano wabendelezi, bakalyambozyanya muli chabo.
Bakati, ''Tulachita nzi kuli aba balumi? mukasimpe mukuti cintu cipati chachitwa muli mbabo chazibwa kuli oonse ukala mu Jerusalemu; tatukonzi kuchikaka.
Ino kuti kambo katainki kunembo akati kabantu boonse, atubachenjezye kuti batachambi limbi kuli oonse muzina eli.''
Ponya baka baita oku balailila kuti balekele cimo kwamba na kwiisya muzina lya Jesu.
Ino Petro O Joni bakataba okuti kuli mbabo, ''Kuti na chibotu ku menso a Leza kumvwida nywebo kwinda nguwe, amuyatule nobeni.
Tatukonzi kuleka kwambola a zintu zitwakabona okumvwa.''
Nikwakamana kucenjezigwa kunji kuli Petro O Joni, baka baleka kuti bainke. Bakabula kambo koku bapeda cisubulo, kambo kokuti bantu boonse balikulumbaizya Leza kuli chakacitika.
Mwalumi oyo wakacitwa malele aya okuponisigwa walindide kale myaka ili makumi one.
Nibakalekwa buyo, Petro O Joni bakabweda kubenzinyina, okubalungulwida zyoonse zibaka bambila bapaizi bapati abaalu.
Nibakamvwa buyo, bakongolola chomoyo omwi kuli Leza okuti, ''Mwami, wakalenga julu enyika O lwizi, ezyonse zili mumo mukati.
Wakamba O Muuya Usalala kwindila kumulomo wo muzike wako, tata esu Davida, 'Kambo nzi nchibatingilala ba simasi, abantu bayeyela nzi zyo buyo?'
Wakamba, 'Bami bansi bakaza antomwi, abendelezi bakabungana antomwi kulwanisya Leza, ape O Kristu wakwe.'
Kasimpe, bonse bobile Herodi O Pontiasi Pilato, antomwi aba simasi abana Israeli, bakali bunga antomwi mumunzi oyu kulwanisya muzike wako Jesu oyo usalala, nguwaka nanika.
Bakalibunga antomwi okucita echo janza lyako oluyando lwako mbuli mbuwaka zikanza kuzocitika.
Ino, O Mwami, langa akucenjezya kwabo okupa babelesi bako bambole jwi lyako chokutayowa.
Vungununa janza lyako kukuponya okupa zitondezyo amalele kwindila muzina lyo muzike wako usalala Jesu.''
Nibakamana kukomba, busena mubabungene bwaka zunganisigwa, poonya boonse baka zuzigwa O Muuya Usalala pawo bakambola jwi lya Leza chokuta yowa.
Mbunga inji yabo bakashoma yali O moyo omwi omuuya. Takwe muntu akati kabo walikwamba kuti zintu zyejesi nzizyangu endike, pele zyonse zyali zyabana muleya.
Munguzu zipati bapostola bali kulungulula bumboni bwabo abubuke bwa Mwami Jesu, pawo luzyalo lupati lwali alimbabo boonse.
Kakutakwe muntu akati kabo wali kukonzya kubula cintu nichiba comwi, kuli boonse bajesi maanda e myuunda baka zyuuzya okweta mali kuzwa kuzintu zyaka uzigwa
okwabika ku maulu abapostola, pawo akaabwa kuli umwi oumwi mbuli mwakabulide.
Ino Josefa, oyo bapostola ngubali kwita kuti Barnabbasi (kokwamba kuti Mwana Udiisya), mu Levi, uzwa kunyika yoku Syplusi,
wakauzya muunda ngwajesi pawo wakeeta mali okwabika kumaulu abapostola.
Ino umwi mwalumi wezina lya Ananiyasi, O mwanakazi akwe Safira, bakauzya cibela cholubono,
okusisa mali amwi ngiba kauzya (mwanakazi akwe awe walizi), pawo waketa cimwi cibela ca mali okuzo abika ku maulu abapostola.
Ponya Petro wakateti, ''Ananiyasi, kambo nzi Satani wazuzya moyo wako kuti ubeje ku Muuya Usalala kusisa mali amwi nguwa kauzya cibaka?
Niwatalina kuchuuzya, cibaka cali chako, ponya nicha kauzigwa, Sicalinsi munguzu zyako? Kambo nzi wayeya cho mushobo oyu mumoyo wako? Takwe niweena bantu, kono weena Leza.''
Kumvwa buyo majwi aya, Ananiyasi wakawida ansi okuyeka kamamanino, pawo buyofu bupati bwaka bawida boonse bakacimvwa.
Bakubusi bashimani bakaza kunembo okumuvungaila, pawo bakamunyamuna okuyo muzika.
Nikwakainda buyo mbuli ma woola otatwe, mwanakazi akwe awe waka njila, katazi cha citikide.
Petro wakati kuli nguwe, ''Ndambile aya na nga mali ngimwa kauzya cibaka.'' Pawo wakati, ''Iyi, ngangawo.''
Poonya Petro wakati kuli nguwe, ''Kambo nzi mwazumizyanya kuti musole Muuya wa Leza? Langa, maulu abaalumi baku zika mulumi- ako ali a mulyango, ayibo balakunyamuna okukutola.''
Muciindi ciya conya wakawida ansi ku maulu a Petro okuyeka kamamanino. Bakubusi nibaka njila buyo mukati, bakajana ulifwide, pawo baka mubweza okuyo muzika kumbali omulumi akwe.
Kuyowa kupati kwakaza a chikombelo ape ali abo boonse bakamvwa ezi zintu.
Zitondezyo zinji amalele zyali kucitika akati ka bantu kwindila mumanza abapostola. Boonse bali antomwi mukota lya Solomoni.
Kono takwe naba omwi bali anze bajesi nguzu zyo kuvwanana ambabo; nekuba namu, bantu bali ku batembaula.
Bashomi banji baka yungizizigwa kuli Leza, mambunga abalumi abanakazi,
mane kusikila bali kweta balwazi mutuzila- zila okuno balazikide mumalo omu miseme, kutegwa Petro ainda, muzuzumbi wakwe ninga wabawida bamwi.
Ape kwakaza antomwi mbunga yabantu kuzwa muminzi izyungulukide Jerusalemu, kabeeta baciswa ape abaya bapenzigwa e -myuuya mibi, pawo bakapona boonse.
Pele mupaizi mupati waka nyamuka, abaya boonse mbali ambabo (kokuti cibela ca ba Sadduki); ponya bakazuzigwa munyono
oku bika maanza abapostola, oko bajalizya mu ntolongo i zibinkene.
Kakuli ciindi ca masiku mungelo wa Leza wakajula zitendele zye ntolongo oku bagwisya, okwamba kuti,
''Kamuya, mukaime mu tempele okwambola ku bantu majwi obuumi obu.''

Nibakamvwa echi, bakanjila mu tempele nibwali kucha okwisya. Mupaizi mupati wakaza, abaya mbali ambabo, okwita nkamu yabendelezi antomwi, boonse baalu ba bana Iziraeli, batumine ku ntolongo kuti bapostola bakaze.
Kono balanga ntolongo bainkide takwe nibaka bajana muntolongo, pawo baka piluka oko balungulwida,
''Twajana ntolongo ili jalidwe kabotu aba lindizi balimvwi amulyango, kono nitwa zoijula, takwe ngutwajana mukati.''
Ino mupati- pati we tempele abapaizi bapati nibakamvwa majwi aya, baka komokwa kujatikizya mbabo mbuli mbucikonzya kuba.
Pawo umwi muntu wakaza oku zobambila, ''Balumi mbimwabika mu ntolongo balimvwi mu tempele okunoisya bantu.''
Mpoonya silumamba mupati wakainka antomwi aba silumamba, oko bapilusya, kono kakutakwe kulwana, kambo bali kuyowa kuti inga bafuswa mabwe.
Nibaka beeta, baka baimika kunembo lya bendelezi. Mupaizi mupati wakababuzya,
kateti, ''Twakamulailila kuti mutanoisi muzina eli, ponya nywebo mwazuzya Jerusalemu okwisya kwenu obuyandisi bokweta bulowa boyu mwalumi ali swebo.''
Kono Petro abapostola bakataba kuti, ''Twelede kukuteka Leza kwiinda muntu.
Leza wama tata waka busya Jesu, oyo ngumwaka jaya kwindila muku mwanzika a cisamu.
Leza waka musumpula ku jaanza lyakwe lye chilisya kuti abe Mwana omwami ape o Mufutuli, kupa kwempwa kubana Izraeli, oku jatilwa kwe zibi.
Tuli bakamboni be zintu ezi, mbuli mubede awe Muuya Usalala, oyo Leza ngwakapa kuli abo bamukuteka.
Bendelezi nibakamvwa namu, chaka bacisa kumoyo okuyanda kujaya bapostola.
Kono mu Farisi wezina lya Gamalieli, mwiiyi wo mulawo oyo waliku kutekwa abantu boonse, wakaiminina oku lailila kuti bapostola batolwe anze kaindi kanini.
Pawo wakati kuli mbabo, ''Nobalumi ba Iziraeli, amuchenjele kuli chomuli kukanza kucitila bantu aba.
Kambo mazuba ainda, Thiudasi wakanyamuka kalilia kuba umwi, pawo bantu banji, ku myanda yone bakaza ku cibela chakwe. Wakajaigwa, ponya boonse bali kumuchilila baka mwaikana kumaninina.
Nikwakainda oyu mwalumi, Judasi oku Galili wakamvwika mumazuba okubala bantu oku zulwida banji. Awe waka nyonyoka, abaya boonse bali kumukuteka baka mwaikana.
Ino ndamba kuli nywebo, amu tantamuke ku balumi aba oku baleka abalike, kambo kuti na aya makanze na mulimo ngwa bantu, iyo mwaisigwa.
Kono kuti na njiya Leza, takwe nimuyokonzya kuba mwaisya; mane muyo jana kuti muli mukulwanisya Leza.'' Pawo bakamvwida.
Mpoonya baka baita bapostola mukati oku bauma ponya oku balailila kuti bata chamboli muzina lya Jesu, okubaleka bainke.
Bakasiya nkamu yabendelezi kaba nonenidwe kuti baka balwa kwelela kupenga kuta kutekwa akambo ke Zina.
Mazuba woonse, mu tempele omumaanda, bakaindilizya kwiisya oku kambauka makani mabotu kuti Jesu ngu Kristu.

Mponya mumazuba ayo, basyomi nibali kuya buvula. kutongoka kwakatakika akati ka bajuda nali kwmbola cigiliki aba Kebulayo, kambo becigiliki bali kutongoka kuti bamukabafu bakali mbabo tibali kuba langanya ni bali kwamba zyokupa zyo buzuba obuzuba.
Abo bali kumi ababili bakabunganya nkamu yabantu okuti,' tacinsi cibotu kuli swebo kuti tuleke kukambauka majwi a leza tugame kulanga zyobupe.
Mponya mwelede kusala balumi bosanwe aa babili akati kenu bazizilwe, bazwide muuya usalala obusongo, mbitunga ywasala kuli ooyu mulimo.
Pele swebo, tulyabe kuzumanana mu nkombyo oku kambauka ijwi.'

Mwambo wabo wakanonezya mbunga yabantu boonse. Mponya bakasala Sitivini mwalumi wazwide lushomo omuya uusalala, o Filipo, Pulokolasi, Nikano, Timoni, Palamenasi, woku Antiyoki, oyo cindi wasandukide okcilizya cijuda katana kuba mushomi.
Bashomi baketa abo balumi kuli basikwiya, baka amba oku bika manza abo alimbabo.
Mponya ijwi lya leza lyakamwaigwa koonse, emyelwe ya ba shomi mu Jelusalemu yakavula loko, inkamu mpati yabapaizi yakaba kuteka okuba olushomo.
Ino Sitivini uzwiide luse enguzu, wali kucita malele ezitondezyo zyenguzu. akati kabantu.
Pele bamwi bantu bakamukazya oku mukatazya, bali be nkamu yecikombelo cabantu bangunukide, boku sailini oku Alekizandaliya, mponya bamwi ku Siliya oku Asiya. Aba bantu bali kukonzya o Sitivini.
Pele takwe nibakazinda busongo omuya Sitivini ngwakambola.
Mponya bakuongelezya bamwi bantu kuti,' twakamvwa sitivini kaamba makani oku sampaula Mozesi o leza.'
Baka nyonganya bantu, bolu pati pati, abamai bomulao, mponya bakamujata Sitivini oku mutola munkuta.
Baketa bakamboni babeji, bakamba kuti,' Oyu mwalumi taleki kwambola makani a sampaula ganda ya leza emi lawo.
Kambo twakamumvwa kaamba kuti Jesu munazaleta uyo katupa Mozesi.'
Boonse aabo bakese munkuta bakamulangisisya Sitivini okubona kuti busyu bwakwe bwakaswana obusyu bo mungelo.

.Nobazyalwa ma anomatata Amundiswilile ,Leza wobulemu wakalibonya kuli taata Abulahamu cindinali ku mesopotamia katano longela ku harani,
Wakati kulinguwe, siya Nyika yako omukowa mponya winke ku nyika njeyo kutondezya.
¨Mponya wakasiya cisi caba kolodiya mponya wakukala ku Haran, kuzwa awo, kabali baisi bafwa, Leza wakamweta mucisi eci, mwakala sunu.

Takwe nakapa kanyika nikaceya kuli nguwe, takwe nikaba kokulyata buyo gulu ali nkako. Pele wakasyomezya nikuba kuti Abbulahamu talina kuba omwana cokuti ulakonzya kupa nyika yecisyomezyo kulinguwe abomukowa wakwe bayosika musule lyakwe.
Leza walikwambola kulingwena wakati, bomukowa wakwe bayokala kwakaindi kanini mucisi cimbi, ape mponya beni nyika okuya bayobatola mubuzike mponya bayobalela obi kwe myanda yone yemyaka.
Pele ndiyo beteka cisi ncibabelekela, mbwakamba Leza, Ape kwakumana awo bayozwa ange okundikomba mubusena obu.

Mponya Leza wakapa Abbulamu citambocokupalula, mponya Abbulamu wakaba isi wa Isaka mponya wakapalula mubuzuba bomusanu otutatu, isaka wakaba isi wa Jakobo, ape jakobo wakaba isi wabana bali kumi ababili bali mbabensiku besu.
Nkambo bazyalwanyina bali omunyono p Jesefa, bakamuzya ku Egypt, kono Leza wali anguwe.
Ape wakamuvuna kuzwa mumapenzi akwe ense. Wakapa josefa colwe obusongo mumenso a Falawo, mwami woku Egypt, oyo wakamusala kuba muleli woku Egypt ape muleli we nganda yakwe yense.
Mponya kwakanjila nzala muzisi zyense zya Egypt o kenani, ape kwakaba manyongwe, bamatata takwe nibali kukonzya kujana cokulya.
Pele Jakobo nakamvwa kuti mu Egypt kuli cokulya, wakatuma matata besu mulwendo lokusanguna.
Mulwendo lwabo lwabili Josefa wakalizibya kubazyalwanyina, ape mukowa wa Josefa wakazibinkana kuli Falawo.
Josefa wakapilusya bazyalwanyina okubatuma kuti bakambile Jakobo isi kuti aze ku Egypt, atomwi abomukowa wakwe wense, bensebalikusika ku makumi ali musanu amakumi obile abantu bosanwe atomwi.
Amane Jakobo wakainka ku Egypt , monya wakakufwa, inguwe a matata.
Bakanyamunwa okutolwa ku syekemu mponya bakakubikwa mu makumbu ayo ngakaula Abbulamu a mulo mu nsiliva kuzwa ku bana becinga ca Hamo mu syekemu.
Ino cindi cecisyomezya nicakasika, eco cisyomezyo Leza ncakapa kuli Abbullamu, bantu bakavula loko mu Egypt.
Kumane kwakaba mwami umbi mu Egypt, mwamiwatalizi zya Josefa.
Wakenena bantu besu ape wakasongelezya matata besu okubenena kuti bosowe bana babo banini kuti bafwe.
Ali eco cindi Mozesi nce cindi nakazyalwa, wali mubotu kumeso a Leza ape wakalelwa kwe myezi yotatwe munganda yainsi.
Nakagwisigwa anze, mwana musimbi wa Falawo wakamubweza okumulela mbuli mwana wakwe.
Mozesi wakaiya kuzwa mu busongo bwa ma Egypt, mponya majwi akwe emilimo yakwe yakaba mipati.
Pele Mozesi nakasika myaka ili makumi one, wakayeya kuti akaswaye bazyalwanyina.
Mukubona bona umwi wabaizilailinyina kapenzigwa, Mozesi wakamugwasya wakamuvuna mponya wakajaya oyo mu naEgypt.
Wakayeya kuti bazyalwanyina balamvwa kuti Leza kwinda kujanza lyakwe walikubapa lwangunuko , pele takwe nibakamvwa.
Buzuba bwakacilila wakabona balumi, bolile balalwana mponya wakakasola kupalumuno akati kabo wakati, nobalumi, momulicenu, ino nkambo nzi ni mulimukucisana.
Pele oyo wakalubizizya mwenzinyina wakantonta Mozesi , mponya wakati, ngwani wakakusala kuti ube mwendelezi omubetesi wesu.
Ino uyanda kuti undijaye, mbonya mbuwakajaya ulya muna Egypt jilo.
Mozesi wakacija nakamana kumvwa bupanduluzi, wakakuba mwenzu munyika yoku Midiyani, oko nkwakakuzyala bana bolile balumi.
Myaka a makumi one niyakainda, mungelowkalibonya kuli Mozesi munkanda a cilundu ca sinayi, mukati mubbibi lyo mulilo walikuyaka muciteyo
Awo Mozesi nakabona mulilo, wakayowa, mponya nakaswena kuti alangisisye mponya kwakazwa jwi lyo mwami lyamba kuti.
Ndime Leza wamauso, Leza wa Abbulamu, ape o Leza wa Isaka o Leza wa Jakobo. Mozesi wakatutuma ape takwe nakasola kulanga nkuko.
Leza wakamba kunguwe, zununa ndasyo ku maulu ako, nkambo busena obo mpoimvwi bulasalal.
Ncozyo ndabona mapezi abantu bangu abo bali mu Egypt, ndakumvwa kutongoka kwabo, ino ndaza kuti naizo bavune, ino koza, ndiyokutuma ku Egypt .

Oyu Mozesi ngubakakaka awo niba kuti ngwani wakakusala kuti ube musololi ape kuti ube mubetesi, ngonguwe Leza ngwakatuma kuti abe musololi o mufutuli. Leza wakamutuma kwinda mu janza lyo mungelo oyo wakalibonya kuli Mozesi musaka.
Mozesi wakabasolweda kuzwa mu Egypt, kuzwa nakamana kucita malele ape ezitondezyo mu Egypt omulwizi lusalala , ape omu nkanda mu cindi ce myaka ili makumi one.
Mozesi ngonguwe nguwenya wakamba kabantu bana isilayi kuti, Leza uyomu busizya musinsimi kuzwa ku bazyalwanyoko, musinsimi mbuli mebo.
Oyu ngonguwe mwalumi wali wo nibabungene munkanda atomwi omungelo oyo wakambola kuli nguwe mulundu wa sinayi, oyo wali antomwi amatata,ngonguwe wakatambula majwi apona ayopegwa kuli swebo.
Kono matata besu bakakaka kumuswilila, bakamutonta kuzwa kuli mbabo ape myoyo yabo yalipilukide ku Egypt .
Ali ciya cindi bakati kuli Aloni, tucitile ba Leza batabatusolwede . Mbuli oyu Mozesi wakayusoloda kuzwa mucisi ca Egypt, pele eli ano cindi tatuzi cakacitika kulinguwe.
Mponyabakabumba mombe mumazuba ayo okupa cipaizyo kulincico, mponya bakasekelela nkambo ke milimo ya manza abo.

Pele Leza wakabasandukila mponya wakacita kuti batalike kukomba nyenyezi zyomujulu , mbubonya mbucililebidwe mubbuku lya bansinsimi kuti, ino kuli nimwakandipa zipaizyo ezituzyo kwe myaka ili makumi one munkanda, nobantu ba izilaili.
Mwakazumina kukomba Leza mupange moloki e nyenyezi ya lefani, ezibumba nzimwaakapanga kuti kamuzikomba, ndiyomutandila kule kuzwa nyika ya Bbabbiloni.
Matata besu balijesi tente lye cizuminano munkanda, mbubonya mbuli Leza mbwakalailila Mozesi. Kuti welede kulibamba mbuli mucokozyanyo eco ncakabona.

Kuzwa awo, ba ,matata besu, nibakainka o Josyuwa, bakatambula tente mponya bakainka andilyo kuyotola cisi cemisyobo eco Leza ncakabatandila. Leza wakatola nyika kuzwa kumisyobo yense mponya wakabatandila kumenso a matata. Itepele lyakasyala mu cisi kusikila mu cindi ca Devidi.
Oyo wakamufwida luzyalo mumenso a Leza, ape wakabuzya kuti na ninga wajana busena bwe nganda ya Jakobo.
Pele ngu solomoni wakayaka nganda ya Leza.
Nikuba kuti, sijulu lyamajulu, takali mu manda ayakwa amanza abantu, mbuli musinsimi mbwamba,
Julu ncecibbula cangu, mponya nyika ncecilyatilo ca maulu angu. Ino ninganda ili buti njatamukonzye kundiyakila , mbwamba mwami, na ino mbusena nzi obo bokulyokezya kwangu.
Ino manza angu takwe nakaanga zyense ezi.
Nywebo nobabicinguni, nomuli emyoyo itasanduki ape amatwi , cindi cense mulakaka kutambula muya usalala , mucita mbonya mbuli mauso mbubali kucita.
Ngwani umwi wabasinsimi oyo mauso ngubatakapenzya,bakabajaya basinsimi abo bakaza kuzoambilizya zyokubola koyo ululeme, ape ino mwababasikumwa ape bajayi bakwe.
Nywebo nobantu nomwakatambula milawo eyo bangelo njibaketa, pele takwe nimwakaibamba.
Ino basinkuta nibakamvwa zintu ezi, bakanyema mu myoyo, mponya bakalumanya ntwino kuli sitefani.
Pele mbonya mbwazwide muya usalala wakalungumana kujulu mponya wakabona bulemu bwa Leza, mponya wakabona Jesu ulimvwi ku janza lya Leza lyecilisya.
Sitefani wakati , langa, ndalibona julu lyajuka, ape omwana omuntu ulimvwi kujanza lya Leza lyecilisya.
Ali eci basinkuta bakasinka matwi abo, mponya bakaongolola ejwi pati, bakafwambanina kulinguwe omuzezo omwi.
Bakamutandila anze omunzi okumuma mabwe. Bakamboni bakabika zizwato zyabo ku maulu omwalumi munini utegwa saulu.
Awo nibacili kumuma mabwe Sitefani, walikwita mwami walikwamba kuti , omwami Jesu, tambula muya wangu.
Wakafugama ansi mponya wakongolola ejwi pati, omwami utabapimulandu acibi eci. Nakamana kwamba namuya mponya wakafwa.

Saulo waka zumanana o lufu lwakwe, pele obo buzuba kwa katalika ma sukusyo ma pati ku lwanisya nkeleke yali mu Jelusalemu, ape ba kazumina bonse ba ka sabalangana mu choko choku Judiya oku Samaliya, kusiya buyo baka tumwa.
Balumi ba dide muli leza baka muzika Sitivini oku lilauka loko kambo kolufu lwakwe.
Kono Saulo waka sola ku jaya nkeleke. Wali kunga unjila mu nganda e nganda, ka kwela balumi aba nakazi, oku ba bika ntolongo.
Kono abo ba kalizuminina ba kamwayigwa baka ku kambauka mu jwi. Pilipo wakainka mu dolopo lya Samaliya oku yoba kambaukila ma jwi.
Pilipo wakainka mu dolopo lya samaliya oku yo ba kambaukila kilisito.
Bantu banji balikuswilizya zyalikwamba Pilipo, omo womwi baka mu mvwa oku bona malele nga mu mvwa oku bona malele nga ka cita.
Myuya mibi yakazwa mulabo bangidwe, oku kwila mujwi pati, abanji ba hole abo batakwe nguzu baka pona.
Mponya kwakaba kusekelela mu dolopo.
Kono kwali mwalumi mu dolopo witwa Simoni wali kucita zyo bulozi, wali ku komosya bantu mu samaliya mane kanze kuli muntu mulemu.
Bonse bana samalia, kutalikila ba nini aba lemu, bali kumu mvwida, bakali,öyu mwalui ngo nguzu zya leza witwa kuli mulemu"
Baka muvwida kambo wa kaba komosya kwe cindi chilanfu o bulozi bwakwe.
Kono niba ka shoma Pilipo na ka kambauka mulumbe wo bwami bwa leza ezina lya Jesu kilisito, baka bazigwa, antomwi balumi aba nakazi.
Simoni lwakwe waka shoma mponya waka bizigwa waka kala o Pilipo cindi conse. Naka bona malele e micito mipati kukola busena waka komokwa.
Ino batumwa mu Jelusalemu niba kamvwa kuti Samaliyya ya tambula majwi a leza, bakaba tumina Petulo o Joniii.
Ni baka seluka, bakaba kombela, kuti ba tambule muya usalala.
Kambo kusikila eco cindi, muya usalala talina kusika ali mbabo, baka bizigwa buyo mu zina lyo mwami Jesu.
Mponya Petulo o Joni bakabika manza abo ali mbabo, mponya baka tambula muya usalala.
Ino Simoni nakabona kuti muya kugumwa a manza aba positola batuma, waka ba somba mali.
Wakati, Ämu ndipe ezi nguzu, amibo, kuti ku fumbwa ngunda jata amanza aya atambule muya usalala.
Kono Petulo wakati kulinguwe,mali oko ka fwide amwi ayibo, kambo wali kuyeya kuti ninga watambula cipo ca leza ama mali.
Tojesi lubono mu eci, kambo moyo wako ta ulaleme kuli leza.
Pele wempwe ku eci cibi cako, oku komba ku mwami, kuti mwendi ulaku jatila bubibo mu moyo wako.
Kambo ndabona kuti uli mu mu lulwe oku nyema okwangwa kwe zibi.
Simoni wakataba okwamba,"amundikombele lumwami, kuti takwe niciyo citika cambwa kulindime.
Ino niba kapa bumboni okwamba majwi o mwami, Petulo o Johani baka piluka ku Jelusalemu, kuyo kambauka malembe mu minzi minji ya ba Samaliya.
Ino mungelo o mwami wakabola kuli Pilipo okuti,"nyamuka mponya winke kulanga ku musanza ku nzila inka ansi kuzwa ku Jelusalemu kuyaku Gaza."
Waka nyampuka okwinka, Amulange, kwali mwalumi kuzwa ku Ethopia, mwiminizi mupati ulemekwa mu Candace, mwanakazi wendelezya ku camali. Wakaza ku Jelusalemu kuzo komba
Wali kupiluka kakede mu cikombelo cakwe, ape wali kubala musinsimi Isaya
Muya wakati kuli Philipo, koya kutala ukale afwi eci chikocikala.
Mponya Philipo waka zuzila kuli nguwe, oku mu mvwa kabala Isaya musinsimi, o kwamba kuti,'ulamvwisisya nzyoli mu kubala na?'
Mponya wakati,ïno mvwa buli ati omvwi andi solwede? Waka tamba Philipo kuti atante mu chikocikala oku kala awe.
Ino muncali wama lembi ngali kubala uyu muntu woku Ethopia ngaya,"waka solwedwa anga ni mbelele iya kuyo jaigwa, ape mbuli mwana embelelel kunembo lyo mwembezi mumunzi, kata juli mulomo wakwe.
Mu kusampaulwa kwakwe buvuni bwaka gwisigwa kuli nguwe. Ngwani unga wamba wapandulula ba zyali bakwe? Kambo bumi bwakwe bwaka gwisigwa kuzwa anyika
Mpawo mwalumi utakwete waka buzya Philipo, okuti,nda kukomba, ndambile ngwamba musinsimi, lwakwe, na ngumbi?
Philipo waka talika kwambola, oku talikila muya mabala waka kamboka mulumbe wa jesu kuli nguwe.
Kabenda munzila, baka, kwaki manzi mponya oyu mwalumi wakati,"bona ngalya manzi awa.Ninzi cindikasya kubizigwa?"
Philipo wakati kuti na ula shoma omoyo wako wonse, ninga wa bizigwa."mu Ethopiya wakataba, "Ndila shoma kuti jesu kilisito mwana a leza."
Pele mu Ethopiya wakaimika chikocikala. Baka njila mu manzi, bobile Philipo oyu mwalumi, mponya Philipo waka mubizya.
Nibakazwa mu manzi muya wo mwami wakatola Philipo, mponya oyu mwalumi takwe na mubona ape, kono wakainka kayo busekelela.
Ino Philipo waka boneka ku Azotus oku kwinka mu choko eci, ku kamboka mulumbe mu ma dolopo ense mane wa kusika ku Caesare
Kono Saulo, wachili kwambola kukonga zyoku jaya basikaiya bo mwai, wakainka kumupaizi mupati
mponya wakamukumbila magwalo oku sinagogi ku Damascus, kutegwa kuti na akujana kufumbwa uzulilwa kuli eyo nzila, nikuba mwalumi na mwanakazi,, kuti akonzye kubeta kabangidwe kujelusalemu.
