Bunji bwa bantu abo baka jaingwa ezi zyumo takwe nibakasanduka kumichito yabo, nanga kuleka kukomba myuya mibi emituni ye ngolide, siliva, mabwe, ezi samu- zintu zitabone, zitavwi na kweda.
Takwe ni ba kempwa ku kujaya kwabo, obulozi bwabo, obuhule, nenga michito yo bwibi.
Ino ndakabona umbi mungelo mupati kaseluka kuzwa kujulu. Kazwete joba, mponya kwali pini congo atala amutwe. Cinso cakwe cali mbuli zuba maulu akwe ali mbuli ndimi zto mulilo.
Wajesi kabbuku kanini kajulidwe mu janza lyakwe. Wakabika cifumba cakwe cokucilisya alwizi e cifumba cakwe cokugoyo anyika.
Mponya wakaongolola mujwi pati mbuli kuvuluma ko mulavu. Nakaongolola mizuzumina uli musanu aibili yakazuzuma.
Mizuzumo ili musanu aibili niyakazuzuma, ndalikuyanda kulemba. pele ndakamvwa jwi kuzwa kujulu kaliti,' lamatika ezyo zyambwa zili musanu azibili, utazilembi.'
Mponya mungelo ngundakabona kaimvwi alwizi ape a nyika wakanyamuna janza lyakwe lye cilisya kujulu.
Wakakonka kuli oyo upona lyense lyense, wakalenga julu ezyo zyeense zili mumo. Inyika ape ezyo zili alinjiyo o lwizi ape ezyo zyense zilimukati, mponya mungelo wakati,' takubi kucedwa.
Pele mubuziba obo mugelo wo musanu aibili nalafwi okulizya mpeta yakwe makani a leza anomanide, mbuli mbwakambilizya mulumbe mubotu kubazike bakwe basinsimi.'
Ijwi ndindakamvwa kuzwa kujulu ape lyakambola kuli mebo,'koya. tola bbuku lijulidwe elyo lili mujanza lyo mungelo wimvwi a lwizi ape a nyika,'
mponya ndakainka ku mungelo ndakamwambila kuti andipe kabbuu kanini. Wakati kuli mebo,'Tola kabbuku ukalye kayoluzya tumbu lyako, pele mukanwa lyako kutolwela mbuli buci,'
Ndakabweza kabbuku kuzwa mu janza lyo mungelo okukalya. Kali kulwela mbuli buci mukanwa lyangu, pele nindakamana kukalya, mutumbu lyangu kwakalula.
Mponya umwi wakati kuli mrbo,' welede kusinsima ape kubantu banji, okuzisi zinji, okumishobo minji, okubami banji.'
Mponya ndakapegwa kabu kokupimya kali mbuli nkoli akwambilwa kuti, koza upime tempele lya leza a cipaililo ababo bakomba mumo.
Pele utapimi lubuwa luli anze lya tempele, ulusiye nkambo lwapegwa kuli ba masi bo bayakulyatauka mumunzi usalala kwamyezi ili makumi one aibili.
Ape ndiyobapa bakaboni bangu bobile nguzu zya kusinsima kwamazuba ali cuulu amyanda yobile a makumi ali cisambomwe, kabazwete cisani ca masaka.
Aba njeisamu yobile ya oliva, amalambe obile zimvwi kumbele lya mwami wenyika.
Ape kuti kufumbwa uyanda kubacisa, kulazwa mulilo kumilomo yabo akubatenta basinkondonyina. Kufumbwa uyanda kubacisa welede kujaigwa minzila eyi.

Mponya balijisi nguzu zyakusinka julu, kuti mvula itawi kwamazuba ayo ngobasinsima. Ape balijisi nguzu zyakusandula manzi kuti abe bulowa akuma nyika amishobo yonse a napenzi kufumbwa cindi ncobayanda.
Ape bamane buyo bumboni bwabo,cinyama cizwa mumulindi utagoli ciyakubalwana. Akumazunda akubajaya.
Ape mibili yabo iyakulala mumugwagwa(eeci tondezyo citwa kuti Sodoma a Egepita) awo leza mpakabambwidwa.
Ape bantu bazwa kumishobo yonse akumilaka, a muzisi, bayakulanga mitunta yabo kwamazuba otatwe acisela. Pele balakaka kuti izikwe mucumbwe.
Pele abo bapona anyika bayo botelwa kukondwa aku sekelela. Alimwi bayo tumina zipo nkambo basinsimi bobile bakali kubapenzya.
Pele nekwakainda mazuba otatwe acisela muuya wa buumi uyakunjila mulimbabo, alimwi bayo ima nji. alimwi abo bakababona bakanjilwa kuyowa loko.
Alimwi bayomvwa ijwi lizwa kujulu lyamba kuli mbabo,' amuze okuno' ape bakatanta mumayoba, basinkondo muina kabalanga.

Ape kucindi eco kwakaba kuzungana kupati kwanyika, ape cibela cipati ca munzi cakawa. Pele mukuzungana oku bantu banji bakajayigwa bali zyuulu zili musanu azibili, pele bantu bakasyala bakaba abuyofu, akulemeka leza wakujulu.
Ipenzi lyabili lyainda. Mulange! ipenzi lyatatu lyobuza cokufwambana.
Mponya mungeli wo busanu atubili wakalizya mpeta yakwe, amajwi mapati akambola kujulu okwamba kuti, 'bamwi bwenyika bwaba bwami bwa mwami wesu obwa kilisito lwakwe, ape uyolela kukabe kutamani.'
Mponya bapati bacikombelo bali makumi obile atone, bakala azibula zyobulemu zyabo mumenso a leza, kabawide balanga ansi okumukomba leza.
Bakamba,' tulamupa kulumba, mwami leza singuzu zyoonse, oyo uliwo owakaliwo, kambo mwakabweza nguzu zyenu zipati okutalika kulela.

Zisi zyalinyemide, pele bukali bwako bwakasika. Cindi cakasika cabafu cokubetekwa ecindi cokulumbula babelesi bako abasinsimi abanyu baleza basalala, abo bakali kuyowa zina lyako. boonse batayandikani abasinguzu cindi casika cokubanyonyona abo balikunyonyona nyika,'
Mponya tempele lya leza mukati kejulu lyaka julwa abokisi lyecizuminano cakwe lyakaboneka mutempele lyakwe. Kwakali tulabi, mjwi emizuzumo, mizumo, muzuzumina, ecivula mabwe cipati.
Ndakabona cinyama cizwa mulwizi kacijisi mitwe ili musanu akumi, ape meja kumi; Atala ameja aco kwakali a minsini ili kumi ape amitwe waco kwali mazina asalawidwe.
Cinyama cindakabona calikozyene asiluwe, azituta zyakali mbuli cinyama maulu, ape mulomoo wakali mbuli mulavu, ape simwuba wakamipa nguzu zyakwe acibbula cakwe abwami bunji.
Umwi wa cinyama mutwe wacinyama ceci wakali yasidwe calufu,
pele bakakomba takakalwe, wapa nguzu ku cinyama eci, acalo cinyama bakacikomba bakati nguni ukonzyene acinyama? Nguni ukonzya kulwana aco?
Cinyama cakapegwa mulamo kuti cambaula majwi akusampaula ape eakapegwa nguzu zyaku cikaka myezi ili makumi one amyezi yobile.
Ino munyama wakajula mulomo wakwe akutuka leza, leza wakatuka zina lyakwe anganda yakwe ababo bakala mujulu.
Cinyama cakapegwa nguzu zyakulwana zyakulwanya basalali akubazunda ape wakapegwa bwami bwakwendelezya misyobo yonse amikowa yonse amyambo yonse amasi onse.
Bonse bakala ansi bayomukomba abo batajisi mazina alembedwe mubbuku lyabumi uyotollwa kulubeta lya mwami ambelele wakajayidwe kuzwa kumatalikilo anyika.
Oyo ujisi matwi, muleke aswilile.
Kufumbwa umwi utola bamwi kubuzike, alokwe uyotolwa kubuzike, oyo ujazya apanga, alokwe uyojayigwa apanga mbubonya. Mbibonya mbuluboneka lukatilo lwabasalali alusyomo lwabo.
Kabele mwami bonse bwacinyama citanzi cakaponesegwa ciyaso caco calufu.
Wakacita zigambya zipati. Wakapanga mulilo kuzwa ansi munyika kuzwa kujulu munsi abantu.
Zigambya zyakapegwa nguzu zyakacizumizya kucita kunembo acinyama citazi, cakabambila ababo bense kuti balelede kucita cikonzyano cacinyama eco cayasidwe apanga ape capona.
Pele cakapegwa nguzu zyakucita buumi eco cikonzya cacinyama, kuti cikozyano cacinyama bajaigwe.
Cabasunilizya wakacita bantu bonse, nikuba bunini nekuba bapati, nekuba bavubi, nekuba bacete, nekuba bazyale, nekuba bazike, kuti balembwe cdinto kumanza abo alulyo nokuba kunkumo zyabo.
Cakali ciyumu loko kuti muntu amuntu aule nakuzya katajisi cidinto camunyama eci cali kwiminina zina lyaco cinyama eci.
Eci camba busongo, oyo ujisi mano abale mwelwe wacinyama kambo ngomwelwe wabantu. Mwelwe njemyanda ili musanu aumwi amakumi ali musanu aumwi amakumi ali musanu ape amusanu omwe.
Ndakalanga ndakabona mwana a mbelele wakaimvwi a cilundu ca ziyoni, anguwe kwali bali 144,000 bajisi zina lyakwe azina lyajisi lya lembedwe amitwe yabo.
Ndakamvwa ijwi lizwa kujulu lyakali mbuli ijwi lya maanzi manjimanji mbuli muzumo mupati ijwi ndindakamvwa lyakali mbuli ijwi lyamanzi lyabasituntuntimbwa mbubalizya ntuntimbwa twabo.

Baimba nyimbo mponya kunenbo lye cibbula cobwami lyabanyama bone elyabapati. Olu lwimbo kakutakwe muntu wakali kukonzya kwilizya pele abo bantu balike bali zyulu zili mwanda a makumi bakaulwa kuzwa munyika.

Mbababo batalisofwazya kubanakazi, nkambo bakalibamba kuzwa kumamambe, mbababo ba cilila mwana a mbelele. Kufumbwa kwaya mbababo bakusanguna kunununwa akati kabatu, kuti babe micelo mitanzi ya leza, oyo mwana ambelele.
Takwe bubeji bwakajanika mumilomo yabo tabakwe cibi.
Ndakabona mungelo umbi uluka muluwo wakalijisi makani mabotu okukambauka kuli abo balikukala ansi okubamasi, misyobo, okumywambo okubantu.
Wakaita ejwi pati, amuyowe leza okumupa bulemu, nkambo casika cindi colubeta lwakwe. Amumukombe oyo wakapanga julu enyika, olwizi atusensa twamanzi.
Umwi mungelo wabili, wacilila wakati, wawa,wawa babiloni munzi oyo mupati, wakasongelezya zisi zyoonse wakabamvwisya waini wabukali bwa mamambe akwe.
Umwi mungelo-watatu mungelo- wakabacilila akwamba, ejwi pati, kuti "na kuli okomba cinyama micikozyano caco akutambula cidinto amutwe yakwe amujanza lyakwe.
Oyo utikamvwe waini wabukali bwa leza utuntwa cakutavwela nisigwa amaanzi mu nkomoki calunyemo lwakwe, ape uyopenzegwa amulilo alufu kunembo wabangelo basalala akunembo bwa mwanambelele.
Busi buzwa bwa mapenzi abo bulasuka lyonse alyose. Takwe kupumula nokuba kanini sikati amasiku, abo bakomba cinyama acikonyano caco abalo bonse batambula cidinto cezina lyakwe.
Obu mboluboneka lukakatilo lwabasalali, mbabo babamba milazyo ya leza, olusyomo lwa kwe.
Ndakamvwa jwi kuzwa kujulu luti, lemba namu, bala colwe bayofwida mumwami kuzwa sunu.
Ndakalanga ape kwali joba lituba kwakalikede umwi wa kozyenye a mwana amuntu wakakede mujoba. Wakajisi musini wa ngolide mumutwe wajisi panga libosya mumaanza akwe.
Kwakasika mungelo umbi anze a tempelel wakaita ajwi pati kuloyo wakede mujoba lyakati tola jekiso utalike kutyola kambo cindi cakutyola casika, mbokunga butebuzi bwe nyika bwabizwa.
Oyo wakakede mu joba wakamvwikula jekiso lyakwe atala nyika yonse yakatembulwa.
Mungelo umbi wakaza anze kuzwa mu tempele lya mujulu, anguwe wakajisi e panga libosya. Ape umwi nungelo wakazwa kucipayililo, wakajisi nguzu zyakwendelezya mulilo.
Wakaita ajwi pati luliyoyo wakajesi panga libosya wakati,"tola panga lyako utebule zya musansa waisi, kambo micelo yawo yabizwa maningi.
Mponya mungelo wakavwikila jekeso cakwe catutebuzya nyika wakatebula musansa ansi okufusila mudindi ansi okufusila mudindi pati lyakusinina bukali bwa leza.
Mudindi mwakalyatokwa anze lya munzi ape mudindi omu mwakankunka bulowa kuya mujulu kukunka kumitwe mutwe we mbizi okunkunka kusikila ku mawelwe wa 1,600.
Ndakabona cimwi citondezyo mujulu cali cipati cigambya. Kwakali bangelo bali musanu amutanyelo uli musanu ayibili, eci cipezo yakali zya mamanino kambo mulinzizyo momuli bukali bwa leza.
Ndakabona cakaboneka anga ndwizi lwa cibboni civwelene o mulilo kabavwi kunze alwizi kali aba bakazundide cinyama cikozyana cico omwelo wazina lyaco. kabajisi atuntimbwa tubakapedww a leza.
Bakali kwimba lwimbo lwa Mosesi, bazike ba leza alwimbo lwa mwanaambele, milimo yako mipati ilagambya mwana leza, singuzuzyonse zitambo zyako zyabuncinzo mwana we nyika.
Nguni utakokuyowa, mweni akulemeka zina lyako, akulemeka zina lyako kambo ndondiwe olike usalala bantu bonse balabola akukukomba munsi lyako, kambo busalali bwako bwaliyumunwa.
Musule ezintu ndakabona kuti itempele yacilawo cabumboni lilijulwidwe mu julu.

Kunze lya tempele mwakazwa bangelo bali musanu ababili bajisilidi azipenzyo zili musanu azibili, bali samide buconzyo, zituba zinyengema entambo zimweka ape zyalijisi angolide zizambailidwe azyamba zyabo.
Umwi wa banyama bone wakabapa abo bangelo bali musanu ababili wakabapa mukeke ya goludu izwide bukali bwa leza, upona lyonse kukabe kutamani.
Tempele yakazula busi kuzwa kubulemu anguzumzyakwe leza. Takwe muntu uyonjila mo kusikila bangelo bali musanu ababili.
Mpawo ndakamvwa ijwi pati lizwa mutempele lyakambila abo bangelo bali musanu ababili, "kamuya kukatile ansi bukali bwa leza buli mu mitiba yanu.
Mungelo muntanzi wakainka amukeke akutila ansi: zilonda kubantu bajisi cidinto camunyama kulabo balikukomba cikozyanyo ca munyama.
Mungelo wabili wakatila mukeke wakwe mulwizi, bwa kasanduka kuba bulowa, mbuli bulowa bantu ufwide zyonse zyalikabona zyakakwe nakalila manzi
Mungelo watatu wakatila mukeke atulonga longa twamaanzi, mponya bwakasanduka kuba bulowa.
Mpawo ndakamvwa yebo ali owali musalali nkambo wayatula zintu ezi.
Nkaambo bakatilayila bulowa bwabasalali abasinsimi ba leza. Wabapa buluwo kuti banywe cibali kwelwa.
Acalo cipaililo ndakaciswilila cilaamba cakuti mbukubede mwana leza singuzuzyonse, imbeta zyako zyalusinizyo ziluleme.
Ino mungelo wane wakatila mukeke wakwe kuzuba. Mponya wakapengwa nguzu zyakatenta bantu amulilo.
Mponya awa bantu bakatentwa lutente lupati bakafwiza izina lya- leza ijisi inguzu zyakutela mapenzi ali boobo , takwe nobakambwa na kumupa mulemu.
Ino mungelo wasanu wakatila mukeke wakwe kucibbalo cacinyama, Kusiya kwaka jala munzi wabo. Nkabela mukucisa kwabo bakaliluma lulimi.
Bakasula leza wakujulu nkambo kakucisa kwabo azilonda zyabo, bakaka kwempwa kuzicito zyabo.
Ino mungelo wamusanu aumwi wakatila mutiba wakwe mumulonga mupati Ufureteti, nkabela mpawo manzi akayuminina mukuti kubambwe nzila zyabami abo bayozwida mumazwido.
Ndakabona miyuya yotatwe uzofwida yali kuboneka anga mba culwa bazwa mukanwa yecinyama nkala cecinyama abasinsimi babeji.
Akambo njimuya yo madaimoni ila beleka malele, alimwi ilendeda kuya kubani boonse banyika kuti ibabungike kunkondp yabuzuba bupati bwa leza singuzu zyoonse.
Amubone ndabola mbuli mubbi uli a colwe oyo ulangila a kubamba zyakusama zyakwe kuti ataendim cinkuna, akubonwa kuusa kwakwe.
Ino bakababungika antomwi mubusena butegwa mucisi ca Hebulayo a Amagidoni.
Ino mungelo wasanu ababili wakatila mukeke wakwe muluwo, nkabela kwakazwa ijwi ipati mutempele lizwa ku cibbaka cabwami lyakati kwamana.
Mbonya awo kwakaba lulabo amajwi amizumo ape kwakali muzuzumo mupati wanyika tekwakabwene muzuzumo uli boobo kuzwa kuciindi bantu ncibakatalika kukala ansi, ikuti wakali anguzu, mupati loko.

Eno munzi mupati wakapandulwa muzimpanzi zyotaywe, aminzi yoonse yabamasi. Ikuti wakali anguzu. Yakawa obo buzuba babuloni mupati qayeyegwa kubusyu bwa leza, wakapegwa cinyido cawini wabukali bwalu nyemo lwakwe.
Mponya zyoli zyone zyakana, azyalo zilundu tezyakajanwa limbi.
Ape bantu baka widwa civulamabwe cipati kuzwa kujulu, ibbwe limwi alimwi lyakali abulemu mbuli italenta, nkabela bantu bakasala leza nkambo kacipenzyo eco cacivulamabwe.
Pele wakasika umwi waba ngelo abo bakajisi mitiba ili musanu aibili wakandambozya, wakati, boola okuno, nkutondezya libeteko lwasikuhuula mupati ukede atala amanzi manji manji.
Ngwenya ngobacita awe buhule bami bansi, abobo bakala ansi bakakolwa waini wabuhuule.
Ino muguzu zyamuuya wakanditola kunkanda, elyo ndabona mwanakazi ulikede acinyama cisalala ci zwide mazina abuzangi, ape cilijisi mitwe ili musanu aibili ameja ali kumi.
Mwanakazi oyo wakalisamide zyakusama zyadowalowa azisalala pyu, ape wakacakatide ingolide amabwe mayandisyi cinywido cangolide cizwwide zisensemyo amatombe abuhule mwakwe.
Ape ankumo yakwe akalilembedwe izina, ndeeli makau asisidwe, babuloni, mupati uzyala basibuhule azisesemyo zyaansi.
Ino ndakabona kuti mwanakazi oyo walikoledwe abulowa bwabantu ba leza abulowa bwa bantu bakajaya Jesu nindakamubona, ndakomokwa.
Ino angelo wakandambila kuti ino nkaambonzi nowagambwa? Mebo ndakwambila makani amwanakazi aya makani acinyama ncatatide cijisi mitwe ili musanu aibili ameja ali ikumi.

Eco cinyama nciwakabona cakaliko, pele sunu taciko, alimwi ciyozwa mumulindi utagoli akwiinka kuya kulunyonyono, nkabela bantu bakala ansi bayoogwabwa, nkokuti abo betana kulembwa mazina mubbuku lyabuumi kuzwa kamatalikiloo anyika. Bayogambwa bakubona cinyama mbucakaliko, ape sunu taciko nwkuba boobo cilaboneka lwabili.

Ngaya maano abusongo. Mitwe ili musanu aibili ngemalundu ali musanu ababili nkwakala mwanakazi. Ape nkabela bami bali musanu ababili abosanwe bakamana kale, umwi mpacili sunu umwi tana kusika. Ino asika awo, ulelede kukala kaindi kanini.
Nkabele cinyama icakaliwo. Pele sunu taciwo, ngucitya musanu abatatu, ngo umwi wabali musanu ababili nkabela uaya kulunyonyono
Cinyama cakaliwo, ape citakaliwo, pele ngo mwami wa lusele. pele ulajanika kuli abo bali ciloba abo bakunyonyona.
Ino mrja ali kumi ngowakabona mbani bali ikumi sunu aba tabana kutembula bwami. Pele balatambula inguzu zyakuba mbuli bami kaindi komwe antomwe acinyama.
Abo balijisi muyeyo omwe,. Boonse bayoba cinyama inguzu zyabo a bwami.
Ape bayolwana a mwana mbelele. pele mwana ambelele nguyobunda, nkambo ngonguwe mwami wabami ngomwendelezi wabendelezi. Abalo abulo bala zunda mbuli abo baitidwe basale basyomi.
Ape mungelo wakandambila kuti, maanzi nguwakabona nkwakala oyo mwanakazi sikuvula njemisyobo yabantu, ngemakamu makamu amasi amyaambo.
Ameja alikumi ngowabona kucinyama aba balamusula mwanakazi sikuvula, balamucazya alike, balamulemunuzya, balalya mubili wakwe akumutenta amulilo.
Nkabela leza wakabika mumyoyo yabo oyu muyeyo wakalonga bukanze bwakwe. Bobse balazumina camoyo omwe jajwi a leza akulondolwe
Ino mwanakazi nguwakabona ngomunzi mupati ujisi bwamu kubami boonse banyika
Musule lyazindi ndakabona mungelo kali mukuseluka ansi kazwa mujulu, wakali jisi nguzu zinji, pele nyika yonse nakamukwa abulemu bwakwe.
Wakalilisya ajwi pati, wawa!wawa babiloni mupati waba bukalo bwabadaimona, waba ciyobwedo camuya yonse isofwede, aciyobwedo cabayuni bonse basofwede abasesemya.
Kambo masi onse alinywide wabuka bwabuhule bwakwe bami bonse banyika bacita awe bwamu, abalo basikulya bensi bakakupuka kambo kakuliyanya kwakwe kupati.
Ndakamvwa ijwi limbi lizwa kujulu liti kamuza mulinguwe nobantu bangu kuti mutawelanizigwe azibi zyakwe mulapenzegwa azipenzi zyako.
Kambo zibi zyakwe zyatanta kujulu, ino sunu leza waiyeya milandu yakwe. Amubwedezye kulinguwe mbili mbwabwedezya anguwe. Amumupe kobili mbuli milimo yakwe.
Amumunywesye alokwe mapenzi anywe mucinyido nciconya cakayisya bamwi.
Mbuli mbwakalimya akulitakanya loko, amumupenzye akumulizya mbonya.
Kambo kako zipenzyo zyakwe zilamusikila mubuzuba bomwe buyo lufu akulila nzala., cobeni uyotentwa amulilo.
Kabela bami bansi bakali kacita awe buhule akupona awe cakulitakanya, bakabona busi bwakutenta kwakwe, bayomulila akumokela. Bayoimina kulekule
kambo kakayowa zipenzyo zyakwe, baita mawe! mawe, munzi ula mpuwo! sunu lubeta lwakwe lwafwambana kusika.
Ambabo basambazi bansi bayomulila kambo takwe muntu uti ule ape makwebo abo.

Makwebo angolide ansiliva amabwe manono amungelo, zizwato zituba anamundelela aziwato zyadowalowa azizwato zisalala, zimvwalimvwali zyoonse zyamasamu amukamba azyameja anzovu azyamasamu manono azyabutale azyamabwe.
Tununkilizyo, tinakinamono, alwamomo atulonze, alibano, amra, waini amafuta abusu butete bunono, ingombe ambelele ambizi acikocikala, ayalo mibili yabantu abumi bwabo.
Sunu yakamanina eyo micelo ibizwa cindi conse yainka njiwali kuyandisya, zyakunyonyokela zintu zyonse zinyengema, zibotezya, tokoyozijana ape.
